text: Why...
Why isn't the emergency state announced?
translation: 为什么还没发布紧急状态？

text: Really, this country is so slow!
translation: 这个国家真是效率低下！

text: And the enemy? Is it a new Angel?
Geez! Where are Shinji and Misato wandering about too.
translation: 真是的！真嗣和美里又跑到哪里去了

text: I'm here!
Sorry...
Uhh, well...
Don't hide your head and leave your butt out... Or so.
translation: 别光顾着藏头不顾腚啊...

text:
Vielen Dank!
Thanks a lot!

Guten Morgen!
Good morning!
If you go in there, the police will get mad at you.
translation: 如果你进去的话，警察会对你发火的。

text:
Der Wurfel ist gefallen.
The die is cast.

With all this physical evidence,
and they still call it "a mysterious moving object."
translation: 明明有这么多物证，他们却还称之为“神秘移动物体”。

text: What's with the public security in this country!?
translation: 这个国家的公安系统是怎么回事！？

text: I'll be late, I'm going ahead.
Hey, honor student! Where are you going!?
You too, Asuka, hurry up.
Let's go!
Wait a minute, Shinjil

Let's play rock-paper-scissors.
Whoever loses, carries our bags to the next telephone pole.
translation: 我们来玩石头剪刀布吧。输的人要把我们的包背到下一个电线杆。

text: Eh? I don't want to.
Rock! Paper! Scissors!
Go!
I am number one!
That's unfair!
You knew I'm bad at rock-paper-scissors.
translation: 你明明知道我不擅长玩石头剪刀布。

text: Ah, that was oh-so-easy.
I'm not walking to school with you anymore, Asuka!
translation: 我不要再和你一起走路去学校了，明日香！

text: A transfer student will be coming today.
translation: 今天会有一个转校生来。

text: Why would anyone move to such a dangerous place?
translation: 为什么会有人搬到这么危险的地方？

text: Aren't you curious?
It's none of our business.
You're scared, aren't you?
Since you're so bad at making friends, right?
translation: 反正你也不擅长交朋友，对吧？

text: Not really...
Rise!
Bow!
Be seated!
I'm... Mana Kirishima.
Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet ya!
Yes, nice to meet you.
Kirishima's seat is...
Please take a seat next to Ikari.
Ikari... right?
Eh?
Tee hee~ Cute♪
Nice to meet you, lkari.
Uuuu~
The class teacher seems nice, that's a relief.
translation: 班主任似乎人不错，这让我松了口气。

text:
If you don't mind, could you tell me
your first name, Ikari?
translation: 如果你不介意，能告诉我你的名字吗，碇？

text: Shinji...
Shinji Ikari.
Shinji, eh?♪
Today I, Mana Kirishima
woke up at 6am for you, Shinji
translation: 为了你，真嗣，我在早上6点就起床了

text: and came here wearing this uniform.
translation: 并且穿着这身制服来到了这里。

text: What do you think? Does it suit me?♪
translation: 你觉得怎么样？适合我吗？♪

text: Yeah...
Hey, can I go to the roof at this school?
translation: 嘿，我能去这个学校的屋顶吗？

text: Well...
I want to go see it together with you, Shinji.
translation: 我想和你一起去看看，真嗣。

text: Eh!?
Anyone will do, as long as it's a girl, right?
translation: 只要是女孩子，谁都可以，对吧？

text: What? Asuka, what is it?
translation: 怎么了？明日香，有什么事吗？

text:
Calling you by first name as soon as she transfers in?
Is she a childhood friend or something?
translation:
转学过来就直接喊你名字？
她是你的青梅竹马还是什么？

text: We just happened to be talking to each other.
translation: 我们只是刚好在说话而已。

text: Shinji, let's go to the roof.
Okay.
Uuuu~
It's so beautiful.

It's New Tokyo-3.
Also known as the anti-Angel fortress city.
translation:
这是第三新东京市。
也被称为对抗使徒的要塞都市。

text: Not that.
Eh?
The mountains.
Mountains?
The mountains beyond the city are still green.
translation: 城市远方的山脉依然苍翠。

text:
I never really took the time
to look at the scenery before.
translation: 我以前从未真正驻足欣赏过风景。

text: It's only been painful things ever since I moved here.
translation: 自从搬来这里后，经历的尽是痛苦之事。

text: Shinji, you're an Eva pilot, right?
Y-you know about that?
Are you praising me?
Ah... I guess so.

It's frustrating that I can't do anything even though
I'm the one who survived.
translation: 虽然活下来的是我，却什么都做不了...真让人沮丧。

text: I envy you, Shinji...
I see...
Look.
This pendant...?
I'll put it on you, Shinji.
Eh, uh, that's...
Don't move. It's going to tickle a bit, but bear with me...
translation: 别动。可能会有点痒，稍微忍耐一下...

text: There, all done.
Thank you...
Shinji!
She's here again.
We're going to the NERV Headquarters!
Eh, already?
Kirishima.
Oh, y-yes?

Please excuse us, we have some
very important work to do.
translation: 失陪了，我们有些非常重要的工作要处理。

text: Asuka, go ahead and wait for me outside.
translation: 明日香，你先去外面等我。

text: I'm SO SORRY for interrupting you two.
translation: 真是抱歉打扰你们俩了。

text: Bleeesh!
Bleeeh...
Flirting away with her...
Isn't it nice to be so popular.
Stop listening to your songs,
and listen to people when they're talking to you!
translation: 别人跟你说话时好好听着！

text: Ah! My Walkman!
This thing!
Ahhhhhh!
My Uchida Yuk!
Hmph!
That Kirishima girl is so disgusting, too.
translation: 那个雾岛女孩也真让人反胃。

text: Making moves on a guy as soon as she moves in.
translation: 刚搬来就对男生动手动脚的。

text: Hello.
Kirishima.
I tagged along.
But what about your classes?
School is boring.
Take me to NERV with you.
I'm going ahead.
Are we going in?
You can't, Kirishima.
You need an ID card to enter.
If we do this, we can get through, right?
translation: 这样做的话就能通过了吧？

text: Like this, we count as one person.
translation: 像这样，我们就算作一个人了。

text: B-but, non-NERV people are...
You're so sweet, Shinji♪
Don't leave the room until I'm done.
translation: 在我完事之前不要离开房间。

text: Okay.
Um...
I'm going to change now,
mind looking away for a while?
No problem.
It's... embarrassing.
I get it.
There, I'm looking away.
translation: 好了，我已经移开视线了。

text: Your skin is so pale.
D-don't look!
So Shinji's the type that wears briefs.
translation: 原来真嗣是穿四角裤的类型呢。

text: S-stop it!
So cool♪
Oh, you think so?
The simulation plugs

The simulation plugs
are now under MAGI's control.
translation:
模拟插入栓
现已交由MAGI系统接管。

text: Strange.
Ritsuko, what's wrong?
Shinji's sync ratio isn't increasing.
translation: 真嗣的同步率没有上升。

text: I can't get any data like this.
translation: 这样根本收集不到任何数据。

text: Shinji,
did you fall asleep?
I'm awake.
You're thinking about that girl again, aren't you?
translation: 你又在想那个女孩的事了对吧？

text: Disgusting.
I'm not!
Save humanity with love, eh?
Asuka, leave personal conversations elsewhere.
translation: 明日香，私人对话请到别处进行。

text: We're in the middle of a very important test here.
translation: 我们正在执行非常重要的测试。

text: In any case, it's not like Shinji could ever beat me.
translation: 反正真嗣那家伙根本不可能赢过我啦。

text: That's going too far, Asuka.
translation: 明日香，你说得太过分了。

text: Hey, wanna play rock-paper-scissors?
Ehh?
If you win, I'll buy you a brand new W-Walkman.
translation: 要是你赢了，我就给你买全新的W-Walkman哦。

text: Eh, really!?
Here we go.
Rock! Paper! ...
Wait, this isn't a good time!
translation: 等等，现在不是玩这个的时候啊！

text: Just once,
think of it as a part of the test.
translation: 就当是测试的一部分吧。

text: Ehh?
The simulation body is acting strange.
Could it be a bug?
The sync ratio is rapidly rising.
He's finally getting into it.
Rock! Paper!
Scissors!
Stop the alarm!
Yes, ma'am.
That idiot...
Delete all the data from just now.
translation: 把刚才的数据全部删除。

text:
Yes, ma'am... But are you sure?
It could still be valuable.
translation:
是，长官……但您确定吗？
这些数据可能还有价值。

text: Hurry up and erase it!
Yes, ma'am.
Eva is not a toy!

If an Angel appears now and our counterattack
fails, it's all over!
translation:
如果现在使徒出现而我们反击失败
一切就全完了！

text: Shinji, are you listening?
...Yes.
It's fine, everyone needs a distraction sometimes.
translation: 没关系，谁都需要偶尔放松一下。

text: You're too irresponsible!
Shinji is not just some machine!
I know Shinji's body better than anyone else!
translation: 我比任何人都了解真嗣的身体状况！

text: Ritsuko...
Hey now, Shinji's living with me, sharing the food,
translation: 听着，真嗣现在和我同吃同住

text: and even bathes in the same water that I do.
translation: 甚至连洗澡水都用同一缸

text: Misato...

How sad would Commander Ikari be
if he heard about this.
translation: 要是碇司令知道这件事该有多伤心

text: You just want to please him.
It's my duty!
Ritsuko!
I'm really sorry...
Hmph!
I'm cancelling today's experiment.
Please make sure to take good care of yourselves.
Asuka, Rei, Shinji, take a good rest today.
translation: 明日香、丽、真嗣，今天好好休息吧。

text: Staying up late is not allowed.
Commander Ikari.
Father.
What happened to the experiment?
I don't remember telling you to stop it.
translation: 我不记得说过让你停下。

text:
It had to be cancelled due to
problems with the Third Child.
translation: 因为第三适格者的问题不得不取消。

text: Ritsuko!
It's the truth!
It's because of Shinji's love sickness.
translation: 都是因为真嗣的相思病。

text: Love sickness?
Shinji.
...Yes?

If you're not happy with piloting the Eva, get out.
You're an eyesore.
translation:
不想驾驶EVA就滚出去
你太碍眼了。

text: Damn it!
Damn it!!
Damn it!!
DAMN IT!!
Kirishima?
Kirishima...
I wonder where she went?
Looks like she went home already.
This kind of meal is just bad.

You need nutrients, like beta carotene,
calcium, and fibers.
translation: 你需要营养，比如β-胡萝卜素、钙和纤维。

text: You don't get enough of any from this, do you?
translation: 你从这里根本摄取不到足够的营养，对吧？

text: Then, why don't you cook something, Asuka?
translation: 那明日香你来做点菜如何？

text: Like cabbage soup, a creamy pumpkin soup,
translation: 比如卷心菜汤、奶油南瓜浓汤，

text: or sardine fish balls.
There's no way I could cook things like that.
translation: 那种东西我怎么可能做得来嘛。

text: Then you can't get married.
Of course I can.
To whom?
♪ Asuka in: Virgin Road Quiz! ♪
Who shall be my future groom?
translation: 谁会成为我的未来新郎？

text: #1 Kaji Ryoji.

#1 Kaji Ryoji.
#2 Shigeru Aoba.

#1 Kaji Ryoji.
#2 Shigeru Aoba.
#3 Shinji Ikari.
translation:
#1 加持良治。
#2 青叶茂。
#3 碇真嗣。

text: It's Kaji, right?
Boo~!
Eh! Why?
It's okay...
What is?
Well...
It's a joke,
laugh at it.
It's not funny.
Here's your consolation prize.
Don't tell me it's Aoba? Misato's subordinate.
translation: 该不会是青叶吧？美里的那个下属。

text:
He's like Takuya Kimura with a long hair,
and he plays in a band.
translation: 他就像留长发的木村拓哉，还在玩乐队呢。

text: Boo~, BooBooBooBoo~, Boo~~~
I feel sorry for him when you say it like that.
translation: 被你这么一说，我反而有点同情他了。

text: I'm all about Kaji♪
translation: 我的心可是属于加持先生的♪

text: Ah~ Kaji, gently embrace me in the elevator.
translation: 啊~加持先生，在电梯里温柔地拥抱我吧。

text: Eh... That's no good.
Here's your consolation prize!~♪
Could it be... me?~♪
Ding ding♪
Eh!
Yeah right, I lied.
Tch...
Uh, I didn't mean it like that.
Don't get me wrong.
Here's your At-Home prize!~♪
At-Home prize?
Here you go.
Take it.
This is for me?
Open it.
...Are you sure about this?
What do you think? I'm the best, right?
Thank you, I'll cherish it.
It was very expensive.
Also,

I want you to forget that transfer student,
Mana Kirishima.
translation: 我希望你忘掉那个转学生，雾岛真名。

text: Huh, why?
I'm home.
Mm~ what a nice smell.
Welcome back.

Welcome back.
I'll make something for you right away, Misato.
translation: 欢迎回家~我这就去给美里准备些吃的。

text: Oh, that's fine, I ate on the way back home.
translation: 啊不用麻烦，我在回家路上吃过了。

text: Yo. How are you two?
Kaji~♪
You had dinner on a date with Kaji then, right?
translation: 所以你刚是跟加持约会吃晚餐了吧？

text: Uuu~
It's nothing like that.
I heard you two went on quite a spectacular rampage today.
translation: 听说你们俩今天闹得相当轰动呢。

text:
Kaji, it was Shinji's hand that hit the wall,
it wasn't my fault.
translation:
加持君，是真嗣的手砸到墙的，
不是我的错。

text: But playing rock-paper-scissors was your idea, Asuka.
translation: 但猜拳是你提议的吧，明日香。

text: Shut up, you!

In any case, it's been a while
since I've seen Ritsuko get that mad.
translation:
不过话说回来，
好久没见律子发这么大火了。

text: Well, you'll just have to be more careful next time.
translation: 下次可要多注意点才行呢。

text: I-it wasn't my fault...
Asuka?

I've never seen Asuka about to cry
like that before.
translation: 我从未见过明日香露出快要哭出来的表情

text: Shinji♪
Misato, how's it going?
Just doing a little shopping.
Is she a friend of yours?
Nice to meet you. I'm Mana Kirishima.
translation: 初次见面，我是雾岛真名

text: You too, I'm Misato Katsuragi.
Nice to meet you♪
I'm living with Misato.
translation: 我现在和美里住在一起

text: Feel free to come visit us if you'd like♪
translation: 感兴趣的话随时来玩呀♪

text: Sure.
Sorry for the wait.
Kajil!
What do you need all that for?
translation: 你拿这么多是要做什么？

text: It's for everyone at the Command Center to eat.
translation: 是指挥中心全体人员的份啦。

text:
And what are you gonna do
if you drop potato chips into the computers?
translation: 要是薯片掉进电脑里怎么办？

text: Computers are hungry too.
Yo, Shinji. Cute friend you have there.
translation: 哟，真嗣。你这位朋友挺可爱嘛。

text: Nice to meet you-
Don't talk to this man.
Keep your hands off eight-graders. We're leaving.
translation: 离初中生远点。我们走了。

text:
What's the big deal? I was just gree,
I didn't even ask her name yet.
translation: 至于这么紧张吗？我就是打个招呼，连她名字都还没问呢。

text: We're in a hurry!
A pendant your girlfriend gave you, right?
translation: 是你女朋友送的挂坠吧？

text: Who did you hear that from?

When you're a man in his 30's,
you can tell without asking.
translation: 到了三十岁的年纪，不用问也能看出来。

text: Her name is Mana Kirishima.
Even though she just transferred here,
she's very kind to me.
Mana?
Do you know her?
Ah, no. Sorry, I misremembered.
Please tell me. What should I do...

Please tell me. What should I do...
after receiving something like this.
translation:
告诉我吧。收到这样的东西后...
我究竟该如何是好。

text: Do you like that girl?
Kind of, I think...
Shinji, if you want to be together with her,
translation: 真嗣，如果你想和她在一起的话

text:
first, keep an eye on her, and find out
what is it she desires.
translation:
首先要留意观察，弄清楚
她内心真正渴望的是什么

text: Keep an eye on her...
And then, if you're planning on confessing to her,
translation: 然后，如果你打算向她表白

text: give her some time to reply.
translation: 给她一点回应的时间吧。

text: Because she needs time to think, too.
translation: 毕竟她也需要时间思考呢。

text: Needs time...
Anyway, make the initiative.
Initiative...
And if things still won't work out, well,
translation: 如果这样还是行不通的话，

text: then you have no choice but to give up.
Somehow, I feel more confident now.
translation: 不知为何，现在感觉更有信心了。

text: Let's do our best, both of us.
Good morning.
Gyaah~!
You, come here for a moment!
Misato... Aaaah!
Wow, you're such a good cook, Shinji.
I always have to cook at home.
translation: 在家都是我自己做饭的。

text: Do you want some help with that?

No, that's fine.
I need to do it myself or I won't get better.
translation:
不用啦。
不亲手练习的话是没法进步的。

text: Just ask if you need any help.
I'll do my best for you, Kirishima.
translation: 我会为雾岛同学加油的。

text: Really?
Actually...
I want you to tell me about Eva.
translation: 我想请你告诉我关于Eva的事。

text: About Eva?
Yo, Shinji! Yer gettin' awfully intimate with Kirishima.
translation: 哟，真嗣！你和雾岛走得挺近嘛。

text: Toji!
That's good, keep it up.
Yer making Asuka more jealous.
Ouch! That hurts, ya moron!

Who do you think is protecting
the peace on the planet!
translation: 你以为是谁在守护地球的和平啊！

text: Yer just frustrated that Shinji was taken from ya!
translation: 你不过是在气恼真嗣被人抢走了吧！

text: What makes you think I'm interested in a brat like him?
translation: 凭什么觉得我会对那种小屁孩感兴趣？

text: Brat... you're the same age as I am, Asuka!
translation: 小屁孩...你明明和我同岁啊，明日香！

text: You're an Eva pilot, too,

You're an Eva pilot, too,
so you're forbidden from flirting with girls.
translation:
你也是EVA驾驶员
所以禁止和女孩子谈恋爱哦

text: Forbidden...
That's right, Shinji! A, B, and C are forbidden!
translation: 没错真嗣！A项B项C项全都禁止！

text: I'm sure they've already at least kissed, though.
translation: 不过他们肯定至少接过吻了吧

text: Please stop! I'm not like that!
translation: 快别说了！我才不是那样！

text: Then why are you always so all over Shinji?
translation: 那你为什么总黏着真嗣不放？

text: ...I'm leaving!
Kirishima!
She's angry...
It's all Toji's fault!
Man, what da hell.
Don't worry about what Asuka said.

She's really frustrated and tired because of
all the recent experiments and training.
translation: 最近连续不断的实验和训练让她既沮丧又疲惫。

text: Experiments?

Even though the Evas are piloted by
people riding them, it's like...
translation: 虽然EVA是由驾驶员操控的，但感觉就像...

text: ...it's like moving your own limbs.
translation: ...就像在活动自己的四肢一样。

text: The experiments are for adjusting that kind of things.
translation: 那些实验就是为了调整这类事情而存在的。

text: Is there no control sticks or pedals or anything?
translation: 难道没有操纵杆或踏板之类的控制器吗？

text: If I think to myself, "walk,"
the Eva will walk too.
And, how far along are those experiments?
translation: 那么...那些实验进展到哪一步了？

text: You're interested in this kind of things?
translation: 你对这种事情感兴趣吗？

text: I want to know everything about you, Shinji.
translation: 我想了解关于你的一切，真嗣。

text: Who's there?

Shinji, I thought you weren't supposed to
tell people about the secrets of Eva.
translation:
真嗣，我记得按规定不能
对外人透露EVA的机密吧。

text: Kensuke...
Kirishima, come back to the class, too.
We have no intention to leave you out.
translation: 我们并没有把你排除在外的意思。

text: It's fine.
That's right. There's no need to force yourself to fit in.
translation: 没错。没必要勉强自己合群。

text: Shinji...
Shinji.
And really, this is all Asuka's doing!
translation: 说到底这都是明日香搞的鬼！

text: I need to talk to you when you come home, that's all.
translation: 只是等你回家后，我有话要对你说。

text: Kensuke, let's go.
Yeah...
Kirishima, don't worry about her.
Shinji, you live together with Asuka?
translation: 真嗣，你和明日香住在一起吗？

text: Uh...
Asuka and I have separate rooms.
translation: 我和明日香是分房睡的。

text:
And it was Misato's decision
that we should live together.
translation: 同居是美里小姐决定的。

text:
It's about pilots needing
to get along well or something.
translation: 说什么驾驶员需要培养默契之类的。

text: Me being with you, Shinji...

Me being with you, Shinji...
it's somewhat troublesome, maybe?
translation: 我和真嗣你在一起...会不会有点麻烦？

text:
Not at all.
We're free to spend our time with whoever we want.
translation:
完全不会。
想和谁共度时光是我们的自由。

text: Freedom, eh...
Freedom is nice, isn't it?

听起来很有趣呢。

The day that girl breaks the final defense line,
will be the last day on Earth!
translation:
当那个女孩突破最后防线之时
就是世界末日来临之际！

text: Asuka, you...
I hate you...
Ikari,
Asuka is very worried about you.
About me?
Who is? Why would I ever worry about him!
translation: 谁、谁会担心那种家伙啊！

text: Bleeh!
Shinji, you believe in Kirishima, don't you?
translation: 真嗣，你是相信雾岛的吧？

text: Yeah...
Let's just leave it to Shinji's judgment.
It's not our job to judge people.

text:
Think carefully about what's important to you,

Asuka will surely get in the way again...

so there are some good sides to her, too.
translation: 虽然她给我买了新随身听，说明她也有好的一面。

text: I wonder if she's really worried about me...
translation: 她是不是真的在担心我呢...

text: What do you think, Ayanami?
I don't know...
You're cold...
You're forgetting something important.
What's that?

The obligation to carry out the mission
given to you by your father.
translation: 履行你父亲赋予你的使命的责任。

text: My father?
What's wrong, Shinji?

What's wrong, Shinji?
Continue piloting.
translation:
怎么了，真嗣？
继续驾驶。

text: No!
Then leave.

Whenever my father talks to me,
it's always just orders...
translation:
每次父亲和我说话...
永远都只是命令...

text: Eva pilot...
He doesn't care about emotional problems of Shinji Ikari.
translation: 他根本不在乎碇真嗣的情感问题。

text: But even my father

translation:
但就连我父亲

Pilot the Eva.
Even my father was able to do it,

so I should, too...
translation:
连我父亲都能做到
我也应该...

text: Lake Ashinoko is surprisingly large.
translation: 芦之湖的面积意外地辽阔。

text: It's a 6km long natural lake, surrounded by mountains.
translation: 这座天然湖泊绵延六公里，被群山环抱。

text: I'd love to see the lake.
It's only a 20-minute bus ride away from here.
translation: 从这儿坐巴士过去只要20分钟哦。

text: But, going alone...
I like lakes.
The weather is supposed to be sunny this Sunday.

I would love to go out and do something
on a day like that.
translation: 这样的好天气，真想出门做点什么。

text: I'm thinking of going out, too...
translation: 我也正想着要不要出去走走...

text: Would you like to go together?
Really!? I'm so happy!

Then, I'll check the bus time tables and a place
we can meet at.
translation: 那我这就去查巴士时刻表和碰头地点。

text:
And I'll make a lunch box for the both of us
and bring it with me.
translation: 我会准备我们两人的便当，一起带过去哦。

Ikari, you're being called in by the NERV Headquarters.
Me?

has escaped into the lake.
translation: 看来不明物体已经逃进湖里了。

That won't be necessary.

From now on, it will be under the
jurisdiction of the Japanese government.
translation: 从现在起，这将由日本政府管辖。

text: It no longer concerns us, NERV.
Understood.

Huh, isn't that Kirishima?

translation:
咦，那不是雾岛吗？
该不会是跟踪我来的吧。

text: This is going to make the day out less fun, for sure.
translation: 这下今天的出游肯定要扫兴了。

What?
Report the situation.

There's a surveillance plane at the altitude of
10,000 meters above us.
translation: 上方一万米高度有侦察机。

text: Looks like we have can't take it easy,

Looks like we have can't take it easy,
good job, Shinji. We're leaving.
translation:
看来没法轻松度假了，
干得好，真嗣。我们撤。

text: ...Yes.
Hey, Shinji, how is it going with your girlfriend?
translation: 喂，真嗣，你和你女朋友处得怎么样啦？

text: ...It's like Asuka said,
if Kirishima really is a spy...
translation: 如果雾岛真的是间谍的话...

text: Then I shouldn't be seeing her, right?
translation: 那我就不该再去见她了，对吧？

text: I see... That's disappointing.
But...
Isn't that just how it is with NERV?
...Do you like Kirishima?
I think I might like her...
Then you just have no choice but to believe her, right?
translation: 那你就只能选择相信她了吧？

text: I have to go somewhere for a while.
I'll go to the bookstore and take the bus home.
translation: 我会去趟书店，然后搭公车回家。

text: Shinji.
Yes...?
I'm on your side.
...Misato?
See ya.
Kirishima is...
...talking with another guy.
That's...

went off with a new guy.
translation: 她大概是厌倦了我，跟新欢跑了吧。

text: No, that's not it...
Maybe it's her ex-boyfriend...
But, what does that make me...
Oh, I see, maybe they're siblings.
But, why would they meet at a time like this...
translation: 可为什么偏要挑这种时候见面...

text: Yo, did you find the magazine you were looking for?
translation: 哟，找到你要的杂志了吗？

text: Kaji.

Seeing him like this,
he almost seems like a normal eight-grader.
translation: 看他这副模样，倒像个普通的初二学生。

text: I'm sorry about the other day, Ritsuko.
translation: 关于前几天的事，我很抱歉，律子。

text: It's okay.
A Sunday date at Lake Ashinoko, eh?
translation: 周日要去芦之湖约会啊？

text: Isn't that nice.
But... I wonder if Kirishima will like it.
translation: 但是...不知道雾岛会不会喜欢呢。

text: Shinji, you don't have to be so nervous about it,
translation: 真嗣，你用不着这么紧张的，

text:
Shinji, you don't have to be so nervous about it,
it's just a date.
translation:
真嗣，你用不着这么紧张的，
不过就是场约会嘛。

text: Here, I have a map of Lake Ashinoko,

so let's come up with a plan.
translation:
给，我这儿有芦之湖的地图，
我们来制定个计划吧。

text: First we'll go to...

Mt.Komagatake,

translation: 驹岳山上风景绝佳，然后呢……

text:
Ride the pirate ship around Lake Ashinoko,
and then...
translation: 乘坐海盗船游览芦之湖，接着……

text:
Walk around the Yumoto Hot Springs town,

translation: 在汤本温泉街散步增进了解，再然后……

text:
...And finally,
I'll take her to the top of Mt.Komagatake,
translation: ……最后啊，我要带她登上驹岳山顶，

text:
to watch the sunset dye the mountains.
I hope she'll like it.
translation: 看夕阳把群山染成橘色。希望她会喜欢呢。

text:
...And speaking of Lake Ashinoko,
I'll save the fun for last,
translation: ……说到芦之湖，要把最有趣的留到最后，

text: and take her to the pirate ship tour around the lake.
translation: 带她坐上海盗船环湖游览。

text:
...And finally,
since we're on the other side of Lake Ashinoko,
translation: ……最后呢，既然已经到了芦之湖对岸，

text:
we'll take a walk around the Yomoto Hot Springs,
there are lots of stores there, and maybe
I'll bring a towel...
translation: 就在汤本温泉附近散步吧，那里店铺林立，说不定该带条毛巾……

text:
It's this late already.
I have to go home and get some work done.
translation: 都这么晚了，得回家处理些工作才行。

Shinji, the feelings of the person you're dating...
Cherish them.
translation:
真嗣，那个与你约会的人的心意……
要好好珍惜啊。

text: ...I will.
Hello, this is Kirishima.
It's Ikari.
Shinji?

translation: 我一直在想这周日该去哪里。

translation:
我们先坐缆车去驹岳山，

最后去源头温泉街

text:
First, let's go cruise around Lake Ashinoko on a pirate ship,

First, let's head to Yomoto Hot Springs,

'night.

Hyuga?

translation:
等所有事情都结束后……
再好好考虑这些吧。

Kaji said so too, I have to
also consider Kirishima's feelings.
translation:
加持先生也说过，我必须
多考虑雾岛的感受。

text:

哦呀…

Mana.

Mana.

Mana...

text: Shinji...

I'm sorry...

translation: 但是，即便如此，如果我成为敌人的话……

translation: 哈哈，Pen Pen大概已经迫不及待想泡温泉了吧。

text:
You really love hot springs,

translation: 明明是只企鹅，却这么喜欢温泉呢。

Are you with Kirishima?
Yeah.

Shinji, ya can't just bring yer girlfriend
to a place like this.
translation: 真嗣，你小子可不能随便带女朋友来这种地方啊。

text: It's not like that.
(Hot springs! Hot springs!)
Toji, let's not get in their way, let's go.
translation: 冬二，我们别打扰他们了，走吧。

Should we head back?
Let's stay a little longer.
Is it fine?
Please?
Okay.
The pendant I gave you?
Yeah...

据推测，这个不明物体是一种新型的
人形战斗武器原型机。

translation:
看起来是在高速移动时失去平衡，
直接撞进了基岩里呢。

太荒唐了。我们不该把时间

Shinji.

你不需要继续待命了，

但我需要听从美里小姐——

...Yes.

Good morning...

The pinnacle of your life.

text:

text: did you know that?
