translation:
我得走了，
代我向你女朋友问好。

text: ...Ritsuko can be very scary sometimes.

Is he the culprit of the
unidentified moving object incident?
translation: 那个不明移动物体的肇事者……就是他吗？

text: Probably yes.

It has a large number of precision missiles,
100mm machine guns,
translation: 不仅搭载了大量精密导弹和100毫米机关炮，

text: and even arms that can grab things.
translation: 甚至还配备了能够抓取物体的机械臂。

text: It's the enemy of us, NERV.
Enemy?
I don't understand why would it attack NERV.
translation: 我不明白它为什么要袭击NERV。

text:
Are you an idiot?
It's definitely because of Eva's existence.
translation: 你是笨蛋吗？当然是因为EVA的存在啊。

text: Why?
Evas are like that.
Like what?
I just said, like that!
So, you don't really know either?
translation: 所以，其实你自己也不清楚吧？

text: That boy tried to destroy an Eva,

That boy tried to destroy an Eva,
that's all there is to it!
translation:
那小子试图摧毁EVA，
事情就这么简单！

text: It's not like that!
Mana!
What are you doing here?
The person lying there is a friend of mine.
translation: 躺在那里的人是我的朋友。

text: Aha~ I see...
So that's the reason you approached Shinji, right, Kirishima?
translation: 所以这就是你接近真嗣的原因对吧，雾岛？

text: You were planning to lead us to a trap.
translation: 你早就计划好要把我们引进陷阱里。

text: Eh?
I just came here to visit him.

That boy you came to visit
attempted to destroy an Eva.
translation:
你专程来探望的那个男孩
可是试图摧毁过EVA呢。

text: What kind of connection you have to him?
translation: 你和他到底是什么关系？

text: Well, that's...
And Shinji, you're so stupid too.
translation: 还有真嗣，你也真是够迟钝的。

text:
There's no way a girl who just transferred here
would just suddenly ask you out on a date.
translation:
怎么可能有刚转学来的女生
会突然约你出去约会啊。

text: Is that true?
It's not!

Shinji, you idiot!
I don't care if you get yourself killed.
translation:
笨蛋真嗣！
你就算死在外面也跟我没关系。

text: I'm going home!
You believe me, right, Shinji?
In any case, you shouldn't be here,

if someone sees you here, they'll treat you
like a criminal.
translation:
要是被人看见的话
会被当成罪犯对待的。

text: Who is he?
A friend...
So you have male friends other than me.
translation: 原来你除了我之外还有男性朋友啊。

text:
His name is Keita,
he's a classmate from my previous school.
translation: 他叫圭太，是我以前学校的同班同学。

text: You don't have to explain it...
...Why would you say that?
I don't want to know about...

I don't want to know about...
your boyfriend.
translation: 我不想听……关于你男朋友的事。

text:
Keita is just a friend,
it's not what you're thinking, Shinji.
translation: 圭太只是普通朋友，真嗣你误会了。

text: Who is it!?
Did I break the good mood?
translation: 我是不是打扰到二位的好气氛了？

text: Kaji.
Sorry for scaring you.

I got called in because of the incident with
the robot's pilot.
translation: 因为机器人驾驶员的那起事件，我被叫来了。

text:
It got a bit complicated,
because the robot is also man-made.
translation: 事情变得有点复杂，毕竟那台机器人也是人造的。

text: The boy is Mana's friend.

I see... the situation doesn't look
very favorable for us.
translation: 原来如此...看来情况对我们不太有利呢。

text: I'm sorry...
Mana?
All of this might be my fault...
translation: 这一切可能都是我的错...

text: Hey, what do you mean by that?
Calm down and listen to me carefully now.
translation: 先冷静下来，仔细听我说。

text: First of all, don't say any more to me.
translation: 首先，别再跟我多说一句话。

text: Next, get out of this hospital as soon as possible.
translation: 其次，尽快离开这家医院。

text: After that, just keep on living normally.
translation: 之后，就像往常一样继续生活。

text: However, you can't come into the hospital anymore.
translation: 不过，你不能再踏进医院半步了。

text: ...Yes.
Shinji, make sure to protect her.
But...
Don't say anything more, just get her out of here.
translation: 别再多言，立刻带她离开这里。

text: I want to know your secret.
It has nothing to do with you.
Maybe it doesn't, but...
You can't learn about it...
Why?
If you find out what it is,

If you find out what it is,
we won't be able to see each other again.
translation:
如果你发现了真相，
我们就再也无法相见了。

text: I promise I won't tell anyone about it.
translation: 我保证不会告诉任何人。

text: I understand, I won't ask again.
translation: 我明白了，不会再追问了。

text: You have your own secrets, right?
translation: 你也有自己的秘密，对吧？

text: I'm sorry for being such a selfish girl...
translation: 对不起，我是个这么任性的女孩……

text:
As long as I don't know about her secret,
it's all that matters.
translation:
只要我不知道她的秘密，
这样就好。

text:
But, if that secret is something important
for NERV or Eva, then...
translation:
但如果那个秘密关系到NERV或EVA
的重要性……

text: Misato...
Asuka...
Rei...
Ritsuko...
I would be betraying all of them.
translation: 我就等于背叛了所有人。

text: When you're giving it your all, Shinji,
translation: 当你全力以赴的时候，真嗣

text:
When you're giving it your all, Shinji,
it makes us all give it our best too.
translation:
当你全力以赴的时候，真嗣，
也会让我们都拼尽全力啊。

text:
It's because of you, Shinji
that NERV has become more lively.
translation:
真嗣，多亏有你
NERV才变得热闹起来了呢

text:
You're doing great, Shinji.
Keep up the good work.
translation:
做得很好哦，真嗣
继续保持这样的状态吧

text:
Your father is really proud
that you decided to come, Shinji.
translation:
你父亲真的很欣慰
你能决定过来呢，真嗣

text: Father?
Shinji.
Is it you, Shinji?

Is it you, Shinji?
Don't call me over such trivial matters.
translation:
是你吗，真嗣？
别为这种小事叫我过来

text: My father doesn't understand my feelings at all.
translation: 父亲根本不明白我的心情

text: Mother would have...
Any response?
None.

Two robots have been sighted,
and only one has been found.
translation: 目击到两台机器人，却只找到其中一台。

text: Is the other one in Lake Ashinoko?
translation: 另一台难道在芦之湖里？

text: It should be, but I wonder if the bait is bad.
translation: 按理说应该在那儿...不过诱饵会不会不太对劲呢？

text:
The robot incident has nothing to do with NERV.
Why are we investigating it?
translation: 机器人事件和NERV根本没关系吧？我们为什么要调查这个？

text: It's a woman's pride.
translation: 这可是女人的尊严问题。

text: Commander Ikari is hiding something,
translation: 碇司令肯定隐瞒了什么，

text: that's why he's playing us.
translation: 所以才把我们当棋子耍。

text: I just want to know the truth.
translation: 我只是想弄清真相而已。

text: So you're being left out too?
translation: 这么说你也被排除在外了？

text: It's rough.
Huh? Phone?
Yes, this is Katsuragi.
Commander Ikari. What's the meaning of this?
Sit down, you two.
Colonel Katsuragi.

You are supposed to be his guardian,
so get your act together.
translation:
你既然是那孩子的监护人，
就该拿出点样子来。

text: So, why did Shinji get called here,
translation: 那么，真嗣被叫来的理由

text: that's what i'd like to hear.
I made a report about Kirishima.
translation: 我提交了关于雾岛的报告。

text: She is a spy, after all.
Asuka!
What!?
Calm down, both of you.
Shinji, did this Kirishima girl give anything to you?
translation: 真嗣，那个叫雾岛的女孩给过你什么东西吗？

text: Like something to wear for example.
The pendant.
No!
Take it out, Shinji.
What right do you have to say such a thing, father?
translation: 父亲，您有什么资格说这种话？

text: Watch your words, Shinji!
You're betraying everyone at NERV.
translation: 你这是在背叛NERV的所有人。

text: Ritsuko...
You were happy about her too...
translation: 你明明也曾为她感到高兴...

text: Hand over the pendant.
If we look at it, she can be cleared of suspicion.
translation: 只要检查这个，就能洗清她的嫌疑。

text: Shinji...
I understand.

Hurry up with the analysis.
There's no need to waste time on this.
translation:
分析动作快一点。
没必要在这种事上浪费时间。

text: Misato...
I'm so ashamed.
I couldn't say anything in front of my father,
translation: 在父亲面前我什么都说不出，

text: he thinks I'm just playing around.
translation: 他肯定觉得我就是在胡闹。

text: Don't worry about it, you did good.
translation: 别在意，你已经做得很好了。

text: You shouldn't be so hard on yourself,

You shouldn't be so hard on yourself,
maybe just go and see Kirishima again.
translation:
不用这么苛责自己，
不如再去见雾岛一面吧。

text: You probably hate me now, right?
translation: 你现在一定很讨厌我吧？

text: You can hate me even more.
But, you know...
I won't lose.
I definitely won't lose to anyone...
I can't lose!
Kirishima and Asuka are absent today.
translation: 雾岛和明日香今天缺席。

text: I guess so...
Asuka aside,

Asuka aside,
it must be lonely without Kirishima, right?
translation:
先不说明日香，
没有雾岛在身边会很寂寞吧？

text: Leave me alone.

But you know, it must be nice
to have such a cute girlfriend.
translation:
但话说回来，有个这么可爱的女朋友
真是令人羡慕呢。

text:
And you have a beauty like Misato
waiting for you at home.
translation: 而且家里还有美里小姐这样的美人在等你回去呢。

text: You're a proud Eva pilot too.
translation: 你可是威风凛凛的EVA驾驶员啊。

text: Argh! This pisses me off!
Where's da fun in gettin' Shinji all full of himself!?
translation: 让真嗣那家伙得意忘形有什么意思嘛！？

text: 'ey, Shinji,

I heard there's a really naughty book found
in da library.
translation: 我听说图书馆发现了本超级劲爆的书哦。

text:
There's talk ya get to see it all.
Wanna go have a peek?
translation: 据说能看到所有想看的画面，要不要去瞄一眼？

text: I'm good.
Don't tell me yer seen them already?

I see, ya knelt before da girlfriend
and begged to see them!
translation: 我懂了，你肯定是跪着求女朋友给你看的吧！

text: Maaaan! Seriously!
I wanna see too!

Let's stop it, Toji.
He looks really down.
translation:
适可而止吧，冬二。
他看起来真的很消沉。

text:
Can't he see I'm trying to cheer 'em up
with my burning friendship?
translation:
难道他看不出我是想用炽热的友情
帮他们打起精神吗？

text: Just let him be.
Oh well, let's just go then.
Excuse me...
Yes, what will it be?
Water, please...
I'll bring it right away!
Welcome!
Hey, Shinji, is the lunch any good today?
translation: 喂，真嗣，今天的午餐好吃吗？

text: Misato! How did you know I was here?
translation: 美里小姐！你怎么知道我在这里？

text: I know everything about you.
translation: 你的一切我都了如指掌。

text: Kirishima's pendant...
It's just a perfectly normal pendant.
translation: 这只是个再普通不过的吊坠。

text:
Aren't you happy?
This proves she's innocent.
translation:
你不开心吗？
这证明她是清白的。

text:
But no one seems to be happy about the fact
that I'm dating Mana, right?
translation:
但大家似乎都不满意
我和真波交往的事实，对吧？

text: You're already all ♪love~love♪ aren't you?
translation: 你们俩已经陷入♡恋爱氛围了吧？

text: Master, beer and a seafood pizza!
translation: 老板，来杯啤酒和海鲜披萨！

text: Yes!
Hey, you should bring her over tomorrow,
translation: 对了，明天你带她过来吧，

text: I'll get off work early and make dinner.
translation: 我会提前下班准备晚餐。

text: We're having dinner?
...Made by you?
Misato works for NERV, right?
translation: 美里小姐是在NERV工作对吧？

text: She's like a kind big sister, and she's on our side.
translation: 她就像温柔的大姐姐，是站在我们这边的。

text: But...
I'll show you to my place.
translation: 我带你去我住的地方吧。

text:
Besides, if Misato recognizes you,
you'll have easier time with NERV.
translation: 而且如果美里认出你的话，你在NERV会方便很多。

text: Okay...
Make sure you'll come.
I definitely will.
I hope it'll be a fun dinner.
translation: 希望今晚的晚餐能开心呢。

text: Yeah, thanks.
Good night.
'night.
That girl, she's coming, right?
translation: 那个女孩，她要来了对吧？

text: Don't fight with her.

If you don't want us to fight,
then you shouldn't bring her here.
translation:
要是真不想我们打起来，
你就不该带她来这儿。

text: That's...
Good night.
I'm going to a stranger's house.
translation: 我要去陌生人的家里了。

text: I'm scared.
Misato's late, I wonder what she's doing?
translation: 美里迟到了，她到底在忙什么呀？

text: (That's right.)
Ah yeah, how are you doing lately, Asuka?
translation: 啊对了，明日香你最近怎么样？

text: Oh, you're getting all formal all of a sudden.
translation: 哎呀，突然这么正经起来了？

text: There's no need for that between us♪
translation: 我们之间不需要这么客气啦♪

text:
Don't say weird things like that,
Mana will misunderstand.
translation: 别说这种奇怪的话，真名会误会的。

text: But~
We bathe together♪
and we sleep together♪
That's not true, we bathe and sleep separately!
translation: 才没有！洗澡睡觉都是分开的！

text:
Oh, the other day,
I noticed some of my underwear is missing.
translation: 啊对了，前几天我发现有几件内衣不见了。

text: Can you give it back?
Mana, don't take it seriously!
It's all lies!
Shut up, Shinji!
Kirishima♪
Yes?
Isn't it wonderful to visit your lover's home,
translation: 能拜访恋人的家，还见到他的家人

text:
and meet the family too.
Honestly, I'm so jealous.
translation:
真是太好了呢。
说实话，我好羡慕呀。

text: Are you family..?
We're not a real family, but Misato decided it's like this.
translation: 虽然不算真正的家人，但美里决定这样安排。

text: However, Shinji is the one who gets the most love.
translation: 不过，获得最多关爱的始终是真嗣呢。

text: It's not just Shinji, I love you too, Asuka~♪
translation: 不只是真嗣，我也超喜欢你的哦，明日香~♪

text:
Thank goodness, Misato.
You're finally done cooking, right?
translation:
太好了，美里姐。
你总算做完饭了对吧？

text: Just leave it to me.
Kirishima, you can relax a bit now.
translation: 雾岛，你现在可以稍微放松一下了。

text: Okay!
And now for today's main event, the poison testing.
translation: 接下来是今天的重头戏——试毒环节。

text: I had to redo it three times.
Third time's the charm, right?
"What happens twice, happens thrice," they say.
translation: 不是还有'有二必有三'这种说法吗？

text: Well then, shall we eat?
Let's eat!
Guests first, please.
Uh, I'll try it first.
You can't!
Kirishima, please give it a try.
O-okay...
...How is it?
It's very tasty!
Really?
Grrrr...
Thank goodness!
Everyone, let's dig in!
By the way Kirishima, what is it about Shinji you like?
translation: 话说雾岛，你究竟喜欢真嗣哪一点呢？

text: ...His eyes, I guess.
Eyes?
Somehow, it's like they shine from deep inside.
translation: 总觉得，那双眼眸深处像在发光似的。

text: his eyes are very beautiful, aren't they?
translation: 他的眼睛非常漂亮呢，对吧？

text: You don't know anything about him, do you?
translation: 你对他根本一无所知，对吧？

text: Now now, let's enjoy the meal everyone.
translation: 好啦好啦，大家先好好享用晚餐吧。

text: Kirishima,
what's your real goal here?
Asuka! Why would you ask such a thing?
translation: 明日香！你怎么突然问这个？

text: Because you're obviously not going to ask!
translation: 反正你肯定拉不下脸来问嘛！

text: Look, you two, don't fight!

Don't worry about it too much Kirishima,
they're always like this.
translation:
别太在意雾岛，
他们经常这样吵吵闹闹的。

text: Asuka,
Asuka, I do
Asuka, I do love Shinji.
translation: 明日香，我确实喜欢真嗣。

text:
Affection, love,
don't throw those words around so carelessly.
translation:
好感啊爱啊这种话
不要随便挂在嘴边。

text: That's why more people end up in tears.
translation: 所以才会让更多人流泪啊。

text: Asuka!
I'm sorry, even though you're our guest...
Really, that Asuka...
Be nice to each other at school though.
translation: 不过在学校要好好相处哦。

text: Sure...
I'm sorry, Mana...
It's okay.
She said what she wanted to say, it feels nice.
translation: 想说的话都说出来了，感觉轻松多了。

text: I'll walk you home.
That's fine, stay here.
translation: 不用了，你就留在这儿吧。

text: We'll see each other at school again, right?
translation: 反正明天在学校还能见面，对吧？

text: Thanks for the dinner today.
You're welcome, come again anytime.
Mana didn't show up.
And the day after that...

All units, as soon as the target
object is within range,
translation: 全体单位注意，一旦目标进入射程范围，

text: enter hold mode and give it everything you've got!
translation: 立即进入待命模式全力开火！

text:
Target sighted!
It appeared by the Kintetsu Department Store!
translation:
目标确认！
出现在近铁百货公司附近！

text: I-it's huge!
It is within range!
Fire!
Captain! We don't stand a chance!
translation: 队长！我们根本抵挡不住！

text: Uaaah~!

The unknown moving object that emerged
from Lake Ashinoko has passed Route 75,
translation: 从芦之湖出现的未知移动物体已穿过75号公路，

text:
made contact with a military tank
battalion, demolished a monorail station,
translation:
与一支坦克营发生了接触，
还摧毁了单轨列车站，

text: and appears to still be moving.
translation: 而且似乎仍在继续移动。

text: Let it do as it wishes.

But it will be problematic
if it damages any of the Eva facilities.
translation:
但如果它损坏了Eva的设施，
问题就严重了。

text: The repair costs will stack up.

It's strategy seem to be just to
randomly destroy things.
translation:
它的策略似乎只是
漫无目的地破坏。

text: It's good for crushing it's pride.
It should learn from its mistakes.

Why aren't we launching the Eva?
It'll be able to easily stop the robot.
translation:
为什么不出动Eva？
它明明能轻松拦住那个机器人。

text:
Because we haven't received
a dispatch request from the top.
translation:
因为还没有收到
上级的出击指令。

text: Originally, Eva's purpose is to defend against the Angels, right?
translation: 原本EVA的使命就是对抗使徒吧？

text:
Angels. Visitors from space who only
bring destruction to us.
translation: 使徒。那些从天外降临、只会带来毁灭的不速之客。

text: Eva. For stopping their attacks.
translation: 而EVA，正是为了阻止它们的侵袭而存在。

text: But, the robot is different.
translation: 但是，这台机器人不一样。

text: It's something that is man-made.
translation: 它是人类亲手创造的产物。

text: It has nothing to do with NERV.
An attack from mankind?
I haven't been told anything.
translation: 我根本没接到任何通知。

text: You see, it's like a hidden truth.
translation: 你看，这就像是隐藏在幕后的真相。

text:
Even a single bullet can lead
to a war between nations.
translation: 哪怕只是一颗子弹，也可能引爆国家之间的战火。

text: War?

That robot... I wonder if it's piloted
by a high school student like me?
translation: 那个机器人...驾驶员会不会是像我一样的高中生呢？

text:
You shouldn't think about it,
there's nothing you can do even if you knew.
translation: 别多想了，就算知道真相你也无能为力。

text:
Isn't it strange to just not think about it
just because you can't help?
translation: 因为无能为力就干脆不去思考——这样才奇怪吧？

text: Shinji,
you have someone to protect.
Kirishima, right?

She's been absent from school for a long time,
and I haven't seen her.
translation: 她长期缺课，我一直没见到她。

text: I see...
The previous robot's pilot was Kirishima's friend.
translation: 上次出现的机器人驾驶员，是雾岛的朋友。

text: Misato, we have to rescue the pilot.
translation: 美里，我们必须救出驾驶员。

text: There's no need for that!
The very existence of that robot pisses me off.
translation: 光是那台机器人的存在就让我火大。

text:
It's almost like they're saying that we don't need
Eva in this time of crisis on Earth!
translation: 简直就像在说地球面临危机时根本不需要EVA似的！

text: Shinji...

Manal! Where have you been,
skipping school for so long?
translation: 玛纳尔！你这些天逃课跑去哪里了？

text: He's not there.
Who?
Keita, from the ICU.
Didn't Kaji say you can't go to the hospital anymore?
translation: 加持先生不是说过你不能再来医院了吗？

text: But, he's not there anymore.
translation: 但是...他已经不在这里了。

text: Maybe they moved him to another room?
translation: 会不会是转到别的病房了？

text:
I asked at the reception, and they said
no such person was ever hospitalized.
translation: 我去前台问过，他们说根本没有这个住院患者。

text: Let's go and have a better look.
Maybe he was admitted under a different name.
translation: 或许是用假名办理的住院手续？

text: Wait up.
Asuka!
Don't start a fight.
I'll go too,

there's no telling what'll happen
to you if you go alone.
translation: 你一个人去的话，真不知道会出什么事呢。

text: But...
That's fine,
it'll be reassuring if she comes too.
translation: 她跟着来反而更让人安心。

text: Let's take the honor student with us, too.
If it's only for a little while.
translation: 哪怕只是暂时一起行动。

text: I got it.
Let's go to the SSDF hospital with the four of us, then.
translation: 那我们就四个人一起去SSDF医院吧。

text: See? He's not there.
I searched other rooms, too.
Since his injuries were pretty serious,
maybe he got moved to another hospital.
translation: 说不定被转去别的医院了。

text: Or maybe he didn't make it...
He's alive!
...Sorry.

Have you heard anything about
him being taken to NERV?
translation:
你们有听说他
被NERV带走的任何消息吗？

text: Talking to us like we're the bad guys...
translation: 说得好像我们才是反派一样……

text: Could it have something to do with the other robot?
translation: 难道和另一台机器人有关？

text: Could it be...
That he got taken back...
by them...
"Them"?
Behind you!
Shinji!
Damn it!
We have to run!
This place is for girls only!
We'll get caught if we don't hide.
I'm going outside,
I can't get all of you involved in this.
translation: 我不能把你们都卷进来。

text: Are they over there?
I can't find them!
You're gonna get killed if you go out!
They probably killed the boy at the ICU too,
translation: 恐怕连ICU那个少年也遭毒手了

text: right, Kirishima?
That's...
Asuka, did you bring your cell phone?
We need to contact Misato.

You're right. This is an emergency,
so I'll use the emergency mode.
translation:
你说得对。情况紧急，
我要启动紧急模式了。

text: This must be it...
Grandpa,
you have to walk faster.
Grandma,
we'll look suspicious if we walk any faster.
translation: 再走快就要引人怀疑了。

text: They look pretty suspicious.
translation: 他们看起来超级可疑啊。

text: A NERV vehicle is parked at the front door.
What!?
Run!
Catch them!
Everyone, hurry!
A car is chasing us.
Ram them!
Kill them!
Why are they chasing us!?
translation: 他们为什么追着我们不放！？

text: Why are they shooting at us!?
Why are we being chased?
It's my fault!
We know that already!
But, why?
Because I'm a traitor!
I'm one of them!
Huh?

We can talk about that later,
hold on everyone, I'm gonna floor it!
translation: 详情待会再说——大家抓紧，我要飙车了！

text: The black car is gone.
Mana is...
a comrade of those guys.
The day you transferred schools,
was it all a lie what you told me?
translation: 你之前对我说的话...难道全都是谎言吗？

text: It wasn't!
But, you tried to deceive me and Misato!
translation: 可是，你试图欺骗我和美里小姐！

text: I didn't have a choice!
Are you a spy?
Are you?
That's right, Shinji.

I'm a child soldier of the army, assigned to observe
the daily life of Shinji Ikari, the pilot of Eva Unit-01.
translation: 我是军队的童子兵，奉命监视EVA初号机驾驶员碇真嗣的日常生活。

text: But I do like you, Shinji,
translation: 但是我喜欢你这件事是真的哦，真嗣

text: that's not a lie!
Do you hate me now?
That's just too selfish...
Stop it, Shinji.
But...
This is not the time for arguing, you two.
translation: 现在不是吵架的时候，你们两个。

text:
Anyway, let's get to somewhere safe,
then I'll contact NERV HQ.
translation:
总之先找个安全的地方，
我再联系NERV总部。

text: What will happen to Mana?

She'll be handed over to the police,
or detained at NERV. One of the two.
translation:
要么移交警方，
要么被NERV拘留。二选一。

text: But that's...

But, what do you think happens if we
just let her go home now?
translation: 但你想过没有，如果现在放她回家会怎样？

text: Ritsuko, are you listening?
It's about Shinji's classmate.
translation: 是关于真嗣同班同学的事。

text:
She's a child soldier who escaped from
the army and needs help.
translation: 她是从军队逃出来的少年兵，现在需要帮助。

text: I'm wondering if there's anything we can do to help.
translation: 我在想我们能不能做点什么。

text: Eh? Doesn't concern us?
You know, she is a spy.
translation: 你要知道，她可是间谍哦。

text: Huh? Absolutely not?
Hey, it's nothing like that!
Ah!
Kirishima, what good does spying on Shinji do?
translation: 雾岛，监视真嗣能有什么好处？

text:
The information I obtain goes to the
robotic weapon development department.
translation:
我获取的情报会提交给
机器人武器开发部

text: The control mechanics are improved based on that.
translation: 操控系统就是根据这些数据改进的

text: So, the reason the pilots are high school students is...
translation: 所以驾驶员是高中生的原因是...

text: because they're copying the Eva?
That's not it,
the reason the pilots are 14, is...
translation: 驾驶员限定14岁的理由是...

text:
because we're training for a war that is
predicted to happen in six years.
translation: 我们在为六年后预言的战争做准备

text: In six years?

So, in six years from now,
the pilots would be 20 years old.
translation: 也就是说从现在算起六年后，驾驶员们就该满二十岁了呢。

text:
At first, we were happy that we're
getting to pilot a new vehicle.
translation: 起初我们还为能驾驶新型机甲兴奋不已。

text: My companions were Musashi and Keita,
translation: 我的搭档是武藏和景太，

text: we became friends while we enjoyed our training.
translation: 在愉快的训练中我们成了好朋友。

text: But, controlling the robot was very difficult.
translation: 但操纵机器人实在太困难了。

text: Due to the heavy shocks,
my internal organs were damaged in less than a month.
translation: 我的内脏不到一个月就受损了。

text:
One day,
saying he doesn't want to be bound there for six years,
Keita tried to climb over the fence.
translation: 声称不愿被束缚六年的景太试图翻越围栏。

text:
But that would have ruined the whole
robot weaponry project.
translation: 但那样会毁掉整个机器人武器计划。

text: So the adults shut us inside the fence by force.
translation: 所以大人们强行把我们关在了围栏里。

text: Everyone got increasingly frustrated,

and started abusing Keita everytime the
adults' eyes weren't on them.
translation: 开始趁大人不注意就欺负起庆太。

text: Musashi and I tried to stop them, but it was no good.
translation: 武藏和我试图阻止他们，但根本无济于事。

text: Everyone just looked at us and laughed.
translation: 大家只是看着我们，发出嘲弄的笑声。

text: Me, Musashi, and Keita joked about escaping with the robot one day,
translation: 我、武藏和庆太曾开玩笑说哪天要开着机器人逃走，

text: but I never thought it'd actually happen...
translation: 但从没想过真的会实现……

text:
I'm also an accomplice,
so it's only natural that I'm being chased too.
translation:
我也是共犯呢，
所以被追捕也是理所当然的。

text: If it comes to that, you can hide in my room.
translation: 真到万不得已时，你可以躲来我的房间。

text:
This time, NERV's Intelligence Department
isn't going to stay quiet about it.
translation: 这次NERV情报部可不会坐视不管了。

text: I'll ask my father, maybe he can help us.
translation: 我去问问父亲大人，说不定他能帮上忙。

text:
That's impossible.
Your father would never help the enemy.
translation:
不可能的。
你父亲绝不会帮助敌人。

text: Mana isn't an enemy!
She's not...

Listen up everyone,
NERV is currently discussing Kirishima's custody,
translation:
大家听好，
NERV正在商讨雾岛的监护权问题，

text: let's wait until we get the results.
translation: 我们先等讨论结果出来吧。

text: So all of your friends were boys, Kirishima?
translation: 雾岛以前的朋友都是男孩子吗？

text: Yeah.

Which one do you like better,
Shinji or those other boys?
translation:
你更喜欢哪个呢，
真嗣还是以前那些男孩子？

text: I can't compare them,
because they're so different.
translation: 因为她们实在太不一样了。

text:
Looks like your relationship is
already heading for a breakup.
translation: 看来你们的关系已经走向破裂了呢。

text: I'm... really happy I met Shinji...
translation: 能遇见真嗣……我真的很开心……

text: Yeah...
Misato's waving at us.

Mana, if you want to contact your home,
I'll let them know on your behalf.
translation: 真名，如果你想联系家里，我可以代你转达。

text: That's okay,
my dad is just a nuisance,
translation: 我老爸根本就是个累赘，

text: and my mom would just worry too much and get sick.
translation: 老妈又只会过度操心然后病倒。

text: I see...
We're going to force our way into NERV.
What happened?
They said the meeting is going to take a while,
translation: 听说会议还要持续好一阵子，

text: and they're probably all just eating pizza anyway.
translation: 那群人估计正集体吃着披萨逍遥快活呢。

text: Mana isn't getting thrown into jail or something, is she?
translation: 真名该不会被关进监狱之类的吧？

text: How can you say such things right in front of her?
translation: 你怎么能当着她的面说这种话？

text: I'm fine.

I'll talk to my father and make sure
you're freed immediately,
translation: 我会去和父亲谈谈，保证让你马上恢复自由，

text: just hang on until then, okay?
translation: 在那之前先忍耐一下，好吗？

text: Yeah, thanks.
I'm Colonel Katsuragi from NERV, let me through!
translation: 我是NERV的葛城上校，让我过去！

text: What are you doing?
Commander Ikari...
I'm asking you what are you doing?
translation: 我问你们到底在干什么？

text: Father! You have to help Kirishima!
Shinji, how was school?
translation: 真嗣，今天在学校怎么样？

text: Never mind school,
return to Dr. Agaki and continue the experiments.
translation: 立刻返回赤木博士那里继续实验。

text: Shinji! Help me! They're taking me away!
translation: 真嗣！救救我！他们要把我带走了！

text: Father! They're going to kill that girl!
translation: 父亲！他们要对那个女孩下毒手！

text: We can take her to NERV, right!?
translation: 我们可以带她去NERV总部，对吧！？

text: Colonel Katsuragi.
Yes, sir.
Come to conference room #12 later.
Yes, sir...
Misato!
Please, father!
Shinji!
Father!
That's just too cruel!
I'm letting myself in.
Kaji...

Katsuragi, how could you just
be there and let that happen?
translation: 葛城，你怎么能眼睁睁看着这种事发生？

text: You left a junior high school student to die!
translation: 你竟然眼睁睁看着一个初中生送命！

text: It has nothing to do with us,

Commander Ikari made the decision,
there was nothing I could do.
translation:
是碇司令做的决定
我无能为力

text:
Is that all that life's worth for you?
That's why women are...
translation:
在你眼里生命就这么廉价吗？
所以女人才会...

text: You sure know how to preach!
translation: 你说教起来倒是一套一套的！

text: You could at least save one little girl's life!
translation: 你至少该救下那个小姑娘的命啊！

text: Leave!
Open your eyes, Katsuragi.
Kaji.
This is my home,
don't let yourself in here again, or i'll call someone.
translation: 下次再自己闯进来，我可要叫人了哦。

text: I'm home, I brought you a souvenir~
translation: 我回来啦，给你带了伴手礼哦~

text: Cream puffs from Cozy Corner.
I'm good...
Say aaa~
I said I'm good...
C'mon, Shinji, say aaa~
Stop it!
I'm not in the mood...
You men are all the same! Always depressed.
translation: 你们男人都一个样！整天垂头丧气的。

text: Kirishima got caught because you're always like this!
translation: 都是因为你总是这样，雾岛才会被抓的！

text: Wasn't it you who reported to my father about Mana!?
translation: 向父亲报告真名事情的人不就是你吗！？

text: Reporting things is my duty! It's my job!
translation: 汇报情况是我的职责！这就是我的工作！

text: That girl is an enemy!
When I took her to Lake Ashinoko,
translation: 我带她去芦之湖的时候，

text: she seemed really happy.
I'm in love with her!
Idiot...
At this rate...
Giving up without doing anything...
Hurry up, will you?
Easy for you to say.
It's so muddy~
Shinji, yer never been at her house, have ya?
translation: 真嗣，你从没去过她家对吧？

text: We're talking about Ikari here, so that's impossible.
translation: 既然是碇君的事，那绝对不可能啦。

text: Ye really goin' that far?
That said, I've heard rumors that she did visit his house.
translation: 不过嘛，我倒听说她确实去过他家哦。

text: Eh? Really!?
'oi, Shinji, spill da beans!
...Just once.
Ahh! Shit!
Why is it always just Shinji?
translation: 为什么每次都是真嗣啊？

text: Hey, be quiet you two, it's hard to walk.
translation: 喂，你们两个安静点，路都不好走了。

text: Now she's angry at you.
Class rep's hysteria.

In any case, why do we need so many
people just for delivering prints?
translation: 话说回来，送个文件何必这么多人一起出动？

text: Well, I guess, I'll just go home then.
Even after coming all this way...
translation: 明明都特意走到这里了……

text: Huh? Seems like she wants you to stay~♪
translation: 咦？她好像希望你别走呢～♪

text: I though it sounded like that♪
translation: 我就觉得是这么回事嘛♪

text: Geez!
Hey, is this really the right address?
This is the address I got from the teacher.
translation: 这是老师给我的地址哦

text: Here it is!
Oh, this is it!
'ey! Kirishima!
Hey, Suzuhara!
Who's idea was to bring this guy along anyway?
translation: 到底是谁提议带这家伙来的啊？

text: What da heck!?
Now now, Shinji's the star of the show today.
translation: 好啦好啦，今天的主角可是真嗣哦。

text: That's right.
Go ahead, Master Ikari!
This isn't the time for that, you guys.
translation: 现在不是闹的时候，你们几个。

text: Excuse me, is anyone home?
It's open.
Alright! Let's go in!
No! I'll go with Shinji, you guys wait here.
translation: 不行！我和真嗣进去，你们在这儿等着。

text: Ye leavin' us out?
translation: 你们该不会是想丢下我们吧？

text: It's fine, let's just wait.
There could be a bomb set in there, you know.
translation: 说不定里面装了炸弹呢。

text: Ehh!?

Is there anything here
that might help us find Mana?
translation:
这里有什么线索
能帮我们找到真希波吗？

text: I understand Kirishima's feelings.
Living at a lake is romantic, isn't it?
But,
I didn't expect her to live at a lake house...
translation: 没想到她居然住在湖边的房子里...

text: You sound disappointed.
She said she enjoyed seeing the lake on our date.
translation: 她说约会时一起看湖景很开心呢。

text: Aww, really?
That's why you're such a child.
translation: 所以我才说你像个孩子啊。

text: I'm not a child.
You don't understand woman's feelings.
translation: 你根本不懂女孩子的心思。

text: I do,

You're saying she just didn't mention it
out of sympathy for me, right?
translation: 你是想说她只是顾及我的感受才没明说对吧？

text: Then,
do you know what i'm thinking about now?
translation: 你知道我现在在想什么吗？

text:
We're just going on about this
while Kirishima is in danger.
translation: 雾岛正身处险境，我们却还在争论这种事。

text: You help look for clues too, Asuka.
translation: 明日香，你也帮忙找找线索吧。

text: Hey, let's move out of Misato's apartment
translation: 嘿，我们搬出美里的公寓吧

text: and live together.
Eh?
Without Misato around,
we could do anything we want.
In there, no one would hear my screams...
translation: 在那里，就算我尖叫也不会有人听见……

text: ...even if you assaulted me.
Stop it, Asuka.
Yeah, right~♪ Just felt like saying that.
translation: 才怪啦~♪只是突然想这么说而已。

text: You got your hopes up already?
translation: 你该不会已经心动了吧？

text: Shinji! Over here!
The robot's footprints.
Huh? It's not Eva's?
Amazing! Robot footprints!
translation: 好厉害！是机器人的脚印！

text: So, it's still walking around!
translation: 也就是说它还在附近活动！

text: What about the footprints in front of it?
translation: 那前面的脚印又是谁的呢？

text: Kensuke's, right?
I didn't walk in there.
That must be the pilot's footprints.
translation: 这一定是驾驶员的脚印。

text: Wha', da bad guy's?
It's Mana.
Kirishima's the pilot of the robot?
translation: 雾岛是机器人的驾驶员？

text: No, the pilot is searching for Mana.
translation: 不，驾驶员正在寻找真名。

text: It must be one of her two friends.
translation: 肯定是她两个朋友中的一个。

text: One of them got caught at the hospital,
translation: 其中一个在医院被抓了，

text:
and the other one is still on the run
with the robot.
translation: 另一个还带着机器人在逃。

text: The first robot crashed at Shiraito Falls.
translation: 第一台机器人坠毁在白丝瀑布。

text:
It's on the opposite side of Lake Ashinoko,
across the south side of Mt.Fuji.
translation: 就在富士山南侧，芦之湖的对岸。

text:
I've heard that there's a military
training ground at Gotemba,
translation: 我听说御殿场那边有个军事训练场，

text: maybe the robots came from there?
translation: 那些机器人会不会是从那儿来的？

text:
One of them dove into Lake Ashinoko, and the other
one went to the other side of Mt.Fuji.
translation: 其中一个潜进了芦之湖，另一个往富士山的另一侧去了。

text: Such distances are impossible for Eva,
translation: 这种距离对EVA来说根本不可能，

text:
the internal power supply only lasts for 5 minutes,
so it would just shut down.
translation: 内部电源只能维持5分钟，到时候就会直接停机。

text: If it gets dispatched and I were to fight it...
translation: 要是被派去和它交战的话...

text:
The only way would be to finish it off
with a single blow...
translation: 唯一的方法就是用一击必杀解决掉...

text: Huh?
Look out the window!
What's that?
It's a military trailer.
Isn't that a person at the back?
Mana!
Mana!!
What a mess!
This is a human rights violation!
Mana!
Shinji!
Why are you in a cage!?
translation: 你怎么会被关在笼子里！？

text: Shinji! Be careful!
You boys there, get out of the way!
translation: 那边的臭小子们，快闪开！

text: Da heck are ya doin', Shinji!?
We have to save Mana!
It's just impossible without any tools!
translation: 可是手无寸铁根本办不到啊！

text: Hey! I said get out of the way you little brats!
translation: 喂！我说你们这些小鬼别挡路！

text: This is really bad, Toji!
Here goes!
What do you think you're doing!?

Just stop it, Shinji.
Yer not gettin' anything done like this.
translation:
快住手吧真嗣。
你这样根本无济于事啊。

text: Mana!
Shinji!
Mana...
We'll start over.
There are better ways to follow the trailer.
translation: 跟踪拖车明明有更巧妙的方法。

text:
What do you think?
Nice binoculars, huh? They're made in Germany.
translation:
怎么样？
这望远镜很棒吧？德国制造的哦。

text: Japanese ones woulda been better for sure.
You don't get it, do you?

The lenses are different, giving a much better
depth-perception, and the colors are more vivid.
translation:
镜片结构完全不同，立体感更出色，
色彩还原也鲜艳得多。

text: After all, it's Carl Zeiss, the pride of Germany!
translation: 毕竟是卡尔·蔡司——德国光学界的骄傲！

text: Carl Lewis? Who da heck is that?
translation: 卡尔·刘易斯？那家伙谁啊？

text: Mana!
Lemme see, too.
They're mine, so I'll go first.
translation: 这可是我的东西，得让我先看。

text: Gimme that, Shinji.
Stop it.
Ah, there she is,
that's just so cruel.
Hey, let me see too.

Oh, you're right, she's left all exposed to
the lake winds. Poor thing.
translation: 哦真的耶，她完全暴露在湖风里了。好可怜呐。

text: I'm going to her!
'ey, Shinji!
What are you doing? Let me go.
Ye can't do it alone.
Let us help you.
Thanks.
But if we all go there, we'll get discovered.
translation: 但如果我们都过去，会被发现的。

text: Damn, it's really hot.
translation: 可恶，这鬼地方热得要命。

text: Hey!
Is the AC working properly?
It's at full power.
You shouldn't ride a tank in Japan to begin with,
translation: 说到底在日本根本不适合开坦克，

text: it's too hot and humid.
Captain, there's smoke rising from the opposing shore.
translation: 队长，对岸有烟尘冒起来了。

text: You're right!
All units! Target the smoke at the opposing side!
translation: 全体单位！瞄准对岸的烟尘区域！

text: My vision is all blurred by sweat...
translation: 汗水糊得我视线都模糊了...

text: Do you want to send a survey team?
translation: 要派侦查小组去看看吗？

text: Of course, you cracker,
that smoke is quite suspicious.
I wonder if Shinji's doin' okay.
translation: 不知道真嗣现在怎么样了。

text: Of course, he's got us helping him.
Can I have another peek with them binoculars?
translation: 我能再用望远镜看一眼吗？

text: No, they'll discover us!
Mana.
Shinji!
I brought you some food.
I'm so happy you came for me.
translation: 你能来救我，我真的很开心。

text: I'll get this open now.
You can't without the key.
I'm just here as a bait to lure the robot out of the lake.
translation: 我不过是作为诱饵，把那个机器人从湖里引出来罢了。

text: Bait?
The pilot's name is Musashi.
He's a close friend of mine.

If I can lure him here,
the UN forces won't have to overwork themselves.
translation:
如果能把他引到这里
联合国部队就不用大动干戈了

text: That's dangerous!
Shrapnel is razor sharp,
You might get hit by some.
I want to save Musashi.
You're protecting him...
You're a pilot too, Shinji, right?
Are you okay with just ignoring him,
translation: 就这样袖手旁观真的好吗，

text: don't you want to help him?
That water column! Is it da robot!?
Where's my camera? My camera!
It's the robot, Captain!
I know! Get ready for battle!
Just run away, Shinji, I'll be fine.
If i can just get this cage open, I'll take you with me!
translation: 只要打开这个笼子，我就带你一起走！

text: Don't! You'll just get dragged into this too.
translation: 别这样！你也会被卷进来的。

text: Why are they shooting here when there's people!?
translation: 这里还有人在，他们怎么敢开枪！？

text: Shinji!
Misato!
We're going to activate Unit-01!
Really?

It'll be bothersome if they destroy
any more of our facilities.
translation: 再让他们破坏更多设施可就麻烦了。

text: Mana, I promise I'll come back to rescue you!
translation: 真名，我发誓一定会回来救你！

text: Shinji!

What the hell are those stupid
tanks shooting at anyway?
translation: 那些蠢坦克到底在朝什么东西开火啊？

text: How did you know where to find me?
translation: 你怎么知道上哪儿找我？

text:
We got a call from the military
that you were near the bait.
translation: 军方来电说你在诱饵附近。

text: Military?

Originally, the robot going berserk
wasn't something that was supposed to happen.
translation: 原本机器人暴走根本不在计划之内。

text:
So the weapons development department
panicked and used Kirishima as a bait,
translation: 武器开发部慌了神，就把雾岛当作诱饵

text: in order to lure out the robot's pilot.
translation: 想引机器人驾驶员现身。

text:
But when they saw it had gone berserk,
they got scared.
translation: 但看到它暴走后又吓得缩了回去，

text: So they asked NERV for help.

If the robot crosses the sea
and rushes into another country,
translation: 要是机器人越过大海冲进别国领土，

text: it would be a major incident.
translation: 那将会演变成重大事件。

text: This is a rescue operation.

Everyone will work together to stop
and contain the robot.
translation: 所有人将协同作战，阻止并控制那个机器人。

text:
If the operation fails, the military
will drop a N2 mine onto the robot.
translation: 如果行动失败，军方会向机器人投掷N2炸弹。

text: The robot, and the boy inside will evaporate,
translation: 机器人和里面的少年都会瞬间蒸发。

text:
in other words, whether he gets
saved or not, is up to you.
translation: 换句话说，他能否得救，全看你们的了。

text:
But if the robot escapes to
the other side of the mountains,
translation: 但要是机器人逃到山的那一边，

text: Eva won't be able to chase it.

If that happens, disconnect the Umbilical Cable,
and chase it at full speed.
translation: 真到那时，就断开脐带电缆全速追击。

text: It doesn't matter if the internal battery dies.
translation: 内置电池耗尽也无所谓。

text: But if the battery dies, it'll be over.
translation: 但要是电池耗尽，一切就完了。

text: All units, hurry to the launch pad!
translation: 全体单位，速速赶往发射台！

text: Musashi...
Uaaah!~
Shinji!
Mana!
What's wrong, Shinji,
hurry and suppress the robot!
But, Mana! The robot...
Never mind that, just ram it!
translation: 别管那么多，直接撞上去！

text: But, that's...
Mana will get crushed!
If you let it go, she'll get bombed and die in any case!
translation: 要是放手不管，她肯定会被炸死的！

text: Hurry!
I can't do it now!
It would certainly not be possible now,

if the cage falls from that height,
she won't survive it.
translation:
笼子从那种高度坠落的话
她绝对活不成的

text: I know that.

Unit-01's sync rate is down by 5%,
it's extremely unstable.
translation:
初号机同步率下降5%，
状态极不稳定。

text: A message came from Atsugi Base, that the heavy bombers loaded with N2 mines are ready for launch,
translation: 厚木基地传来消息，装载N2炸弹的重型轰炸机已准备就绪

text: they're asking us to report how the situation develops.
translation: 他们要求我们汇报局势进展。

text:
The Japanese government and the military
command have interrupted the line,
translation: 日本政府和军方司令部切断了通讯线路，

text: what should we do?
Cancel all of them.
Asuka, are you listening?
I was expecting you to call me.

OK! When I give you a signal,
ram the robot from the side.
translation:
好！等我发出信号，
就从侧面撞击那个机器人。

text: Shinji's girlfriend will get hurt pretty bad, but okay.
translation: 真嗣的女朋友可能会伤得不轻，不过没问题。

text: There's no other way, please.
Leave it to me.
I'll ram it with all I got.
Rei.
The robot might try and go over Mt.Nagao's peak,
translation: 那台机器人可能会试图翻过长尾山山顶，

text:
and if it does, I don't care if you destroy it,
just make sure to stop it.
translation:
如果它真的这么做，就算摧毁它也无所谓，
务必阻止它。

text: Understood.
Colonel Katsuragi.
Yes?
Don't damage Unit-01.
But, clashes are bound to happen in combat.
translation: 但是，战斗中难免会发生碰撞。

text: Order Unit-01 to retreat.
The rescue operation comes first.
It's useless...
It'll be over in 10 minutes.

Don't get us involved in this
faux act of kindness of yours,
translation: 别把我们卷进你这虚伪的善意里，

text:
order the bloodthirsty bombers
at Atsugi Base to take off.
translation: 立刻命令厚木基地那群嗜血的轰炸机起飞。

text: ...Understood.
Aoba, keep reporting the situation to Atsugi Base.
translation: 青叶，继续向厚木基地汇报情况。

text: Yes, ma'am.
Please wait!

Shinji, the retreat order was given,
get away from there.
translation: 真嗣，撤退命令已下达，快离开那里。

text: No!
If I can catch her, she'll be saved!
translation: 只要能抓住她，就能救她！

text: They're going to bomb her to death!
Father!

Operations Commander,
what happened to the operation?
translation: 作战指挥官，作战计划怎么样了？

text: Asuka, start the assault.
Here I go! Oryaaaa!
Taaaaa!~
Shit! I won't let you!
translation: 可恶！我绝不会让你得逞！

text: Shinji!
Shinji, you're in the way!
The robot is escaping!
Mana!
Shinji!
The target robot weapon has started moving,
translation: 目标机器人兵器开始移动了，

text: Unit-01 and Unit-02 are chasing it.
translation: 初号机和二号机正在追击。

text:
The bombers carrying N2 mines
have left from Atsugi Air Base.
translation:
搭载N2爆雷的轰炸机
已从厚木空军基地出发。

text: Arrival time is 5 minutes.
Unit-01 disconnected the Umbilical Cable, 5 minutes of operation time remaining. Unit-02 also cut the Cable.
translation: 初号机断开脐带电缆，剩余活动时间5分钟。二号机也切断了电缆。

text: Rei, the target is approaching your direction.
translation: 零，目标正在朝你的方向接近。

text: Please!
Understood.
Target has come in contact with Unit-00.
Unit-00 has taken a strong hit.
It's no good! The target is crossing the mountain peak.
translation: 不行！目标正在翻越山顶。

text: Message received from Gotemba Station,
translation: 收到御殿场站传来的消息，

text: they have a visual contact on the robot.
translation: 他们已目击到机器人踪迹。

text:
An emergency evacuation order
has been issued for Gotemba City.
translation: 御殿场市已发布紧急疏散指令。

text: Unit-00 has severed it's Umbilical Cable!
translation: 零号机切断了脐带电缆！

text: All units are pursuing the target!
Shinji!
Shit, the enemy is too fast!
translation: 可恶，敌人的速度太快了！

text:
Target has now passed Gotemba City and
is heading towards Mt.Ashitaka.
translation: 目标已越过御殿场市，正朝爱鹰山方向移动。

text: Incoming message from the military central command!
translation: 收到军部中央指挥部的通讯！

text: They're telling us to get Eva out of the way.
translation: 他们命令我们让Eva撤离当前区域。

text: Target is getting away from Unit-01.
translation: 目标正在脱离初号机的追踪范围。

text: Bomber is calculating target coordinates.
translation: 轰炸机正在计算目标坐标。

text: The bomb hatch is opening.
Unit-01 has less than a minute left in it's battery!
translation: 初号机的电池剩余时间不足一分钟！

text: Further pursuit is dangerous.
Message received from Gotemba Station,
translation: 收到御殿场站传来的通讯，

text: they're losing sight of the target!
translation: 目标正在脱离监控范围！

text:
The military command is demanding
that we stop the Eva again!
translation: 军部正在强令我们再次停止EVA行动！

text: Unit-01, abort mission!
I can still do this!
Ritsuko!
Send the termination signal to Unit-01!
translation: 向初号机发送强制终止信号！

text: Termination signal sent! It's being refused!
translation: 终止信号已发送！但被拒绝了！

text: Unit-01 has gone berserk!
Rei Asuka! Change of plans, catch Shinji!
translation: 明日香！计划变更，快去接应真嗣！

text: Shinji!
Unit-01 has shut down!
Mana.
Bomber's location is confirmed to be above Unit-01.
translation: 确认轰炸机位于初号机正上方。

text: Ten seconds until the N2 mine is deployed.

This is bad!
Unit-01's Entry Plug has been ejected.
translation:
糟了！
初号机的插入栓被弹射出来了。

text:
Abort the bombing!
Hurry up and send them a message!
translation:
取消轰炸！
快给他们发讯息！

text: Oh no! This is bad!
Rei! Carry Unit-01 and escape from there!
translation: 零！带着初号机撤离那里！

text: Understood.
Asuka! Do you read me? Asuka!
translation: 明日香！能听到吗？明日香！

text: Unit-02 Entry Plug has also been ejected!
translation: 二号机的插入栓也被弹射出去了！

text: We can't stop them in time!
The N2 mine has been dropped!
Dear god...
I really did like you, Shinji.
translation: 我其实真的很喜欢你哦，真嗣。

text: The date was very enjoyable.
And the dinner at Misato's...
translation: 还有在美里家吃的晚餐...

text: eating together with everyone was great.
translation: 和大家一起吃饭的时光真的很美好。

text: But, it all ends here.
translation: 但是，一切就在这里结束吧。

text: I'll make it easier for you.
Sorry.
Goodbye,
Shinji.
Don't be reckless.
She's still alive, right?
Give it up already.
She's alive...
If you're fine with it,

If you're fine with it,
I wouldn't mind being Kirishima's substitute.
translation: 如果你不介意的话，我来当雾岛的替补也没关系哦。

text: I don't want that.
Don't get me wrong! It's only for NERV's sake!
translation: 别误会！这只是为了NERV着想！

text: Mana...
Nothing...
Aah! My Unit-02 is all messed up!
translation: 啊啊！我的二号机变得破破烂烂的了！

text: Mana.
If you're here, please answer me...
translation: 如果你在这里的话，请回答我……

text: We'll look for her later.
No, if she's buried or something, we need to dig her up...
translation: 不，如果她被埋住了什么的，我们得把她挖出来……

text: Could it be?
Mana...
It's the robot, all melted from the heat.
translation: 是那个机器人，被高温彻底熔化了。

text: You're wrong...
This isn't the robot.
It must have escaped...
It's already far away...
Where no one bothers it.
translation: 逃到谁也打扰不到的地方。

text: Far away...

Message received from the military HQ,
"Operation succeeded."
translation:
收到军部总部的通讯——
"作战成功"

text: They are asking about damages to NERV.
translation: 他们正在询问NERV的受损情况

text: There is none.
Check if there are any survivors from the robot.
translation: 检查机器人内部是否有幸存者

text: Survivors from the robot...
zero.

All that has been confirmed is the melted lump
of metal at the center of the explosion...
translation:
唯一能确认的只有爆炸中心
那团熔化的金属块...

text: ...that's what they said.
I think Mana is still alive.
I see...
How do you know?
Just stop already.
I know.

Because the pilot believed he could save her,
and held onto Mana.
translation:
因为驾驶员坚信自己能救她
始终紧抱着真名不放

text:
Now they're somewhere waiting
for the rescue to come.
translation:
此刻他们正在某处
等待着救援的到来

text: That might be the case...
How do you explain the lump of metal?
translation: 那堆金属残骸又该怎么解释？

text: That's...
That might be all that's left of the robot,
translation: 恐怕是机器人仅存的残骸了

text:
But I'm sure there's some kind of life
capsule they used, being buried somewhere.
translation: 但我敢肯定，他们使用的某种生命维持舱，就埋藏在某处。

text: We have to rescue them as soon as possible.
translation: 我们必须尽快救出他们。

text: We can't do that,

Because ours,
NERV's involvement in the matter is over.
translation: 因为我们的——NERV在这件事上的介入已经结束了。

text: Why did you ignore the retreat order?

If you ever damage Eva again,
you'll be relieved of piloting it.
translation: 如果再让EVA受损，你将被解除驾驶员职务。

text: It's your Eva, isn't it Father?
Why don't you just do things as you wish!?
translation: 你为什么不按自己的意愿行事！？

text: Just dismiss me right now!
Shinji...
Go get some rest.
A commemorative photo?
Mana asked a person passing by to take it for us.
translation: 真名请路过的人帮我们拍的。

text:
Man, I wanna go to a date like that,
how'd ya ask her out?
translation:
哇~我也好想这样约会啊，
你是怎么约到她的？

text: How did I...

Now's not a good time to
ask him something like that.
translation: 现在不是问这种问题的时候。

text:
Tch. He made us look for da capsule too,
whats wrong with makin' a joke?
translation:
切，他让我们找胶囊的时候够呛，
开个玩笑怎么了？

text: ...Sorry, I made you stay here with me all night.
translation: ...抱歉，让你陪我在这种地方熬了一整夜。

text: There was no life capsule after all.
translation: 结果根本没有什么生命胶囊嘛。

text: I understand it now,
I was an idiot...
translation: 我真是个彻头彻尾的笨蛋...

text:
That again? Ya were all excited 'bout
finding Kirishima earlier,
translation: 又来了？白天还兴冲冲地说要找到雾岛，

text: then, night comes and ya get a little tired,
translation: 结果天一黑稍微累点儿，

text: and that's da conclusion yer come to?
Ya really are a carefree man, ya know.
Stop it, Toji.

Ya give up so easily now that Kirishima's
no longer 'round, ya know.
translation: 雾岛一不在身边就轻易放弃，这样可不行啊。

text: I know what's up.
Shinji!
Yer goin' to hook up with Asuka, aren't ya?
translation: 你小子是要去和明日香约会吧？

text: Asuka has nothing to do with this!

She and ya both do whatever ye want without
understanding da feelings of people 'round ya!
translation: 你和那丫头从来只顾自己痛快，根本不在乎周围人的感受！

text: So shameless!
Don't insult Asuka!
Ye defyin' me?
You okay, Shinji?
You didn't have to hit him, Toji!
translation: 用不着动手打他啊，冬二！

text: I'm leavin'! No way I can stick up for him!
translation: 我先走了！这种家伙我可护不住！

text:
He left...
walking home at this time of the night...
translation:
他走了...
深更半夜的一个人走回家...

text:
Let me have a look at your face and
I'll disinfect it.
translation:
让我看看你的脸，
我来帮你消毒。

text: I'm irresponsible anyway...
translation: 反正我就是个不负责任的人...

text: Don't be so hard on yourself,

he's just a little jealous, you get to ride Eva, and
have Misato and Asuka at home worrying about you.
translation:
他只是有点嫉妒，毕竟你能驾驶EVA，
还有美里和明日香在家担心着你。

text:
And you had a date with Kirishima too,
what a nice memory.
translation:
而且你还和雾岛约会过呢，
真是美好的回忆啊。

text:
It's nice.
I don't have anything like that in my life either.
translation:
真好啊。
像我的人生里可没有这种经历。

text: ...Eva belongs to my father.
I'm just being used by him.
Misato and Asuka worry about me,
translation: 美里和明日香都在担心我，

text: but I can't give them any answers.
translation: 但我却无法给她们任何答案。

text: Mana...
She disappeared somewhere...
And these memories are just painful...
translation: 而这些记忆只会带来痛苦...

text: I don't want them...
Asuka is...
She's always looking at you during class...

If you decide to get together with Asuka,
you'll be despised for that.
translation:
如果你决定和明日香在一起，
会因此遭人非议的。

text: But, no one will be able to stop you...
I'm home...
The pendant Mana gave me,
what should I do with it...
Returning it to her parents would be the best, but...
translation: 交还给她父母应该最合适，可是...

text: Shinji?
You've returned?
Did I wake you up?
I couldn't sleep,
did you find Kirishima?
It was no good...
I see...
Hey, Asuka...
What is it?
Are you hungry?
I can't cook anything.
I'll cook,
that's why, umm...
I don't want it, it'll make me fat.
Where's Misato?
I think she's working overtime.
I see...

You're acting all weird. Searching all over
the mountains must have worn you out.
translation: 你有点反常啊。是不是今天满山遍野的搜查太累了？

text: Uh... You think so?
I'm going to bed now, good night.
Wait a bit.
What is it?
I'm sorry about everything.
translation: 对于所有的一切...我很抱歉。

text: It's fine...
Somehow...
I feel like I'm useless...
Stop whining,
I'm going to bed,
good night...

Well then, we've all had
our share of mackerel, are we all awake?
translation: 那么，既然大家都分到了鲭鱼，应该都清醒了吧？

text: Hey now! Cheer up,
time for some stretching!
One
Two
Three
Four,
Two
Two
Three
Four!
Come on, Shinji, you do the same.
...One, two, three, four...Two, two, three, four.

More like this!
Stretch your arms and place your fingers like this!
translation:
要像这样！
手臂伸直，手指摆成这个姿势！

text: Owww...
Asuka, you do it too. It'll make you feel better.
translation: 明日香，你也试试。这样会舒服些。

text: Thank you for the meal...
Huh? Going out already?
Good morning!
I'll go ahead.
Asuka.
What?
I'm sorry... about last night.
It's okay.
I'm going now.
What's this?
Ah, it's nothing.
What's this nothing?
It'd be nice if you'd tell me~♪
That's okay,
I'll go and wash the dishes.
The reason Kirishima couldn't be saved,
it was my fault, wasn't it?
Misato,
That's... not true.

Ah, we can't stay depressed when it's
such nice weather, can we?
translation: 啊，天气这么好，我们可不能一直消沉下去呢。

text: I'm going to do my best today.
I wonder what I'm going to do now.
translation: 接下来该做些什么好呢。

text: I should consider Asuka a little...
translation: 得稍微考虑下明日香的事了...

text: I don't care if everyone thinks I'm a lousy guy.
translation: 就算被大家当成差劲的家伙也无所谓。

text:
If I keep thinking about Mana,
I'm going to lose it...
translation: 要是继续想着真名的事，我大概会崩溃的...

text:
I already searched the mountains,
so maybe the sea this time...
translation: 山里已经搜过了...这次或许该去海边看看。

text:
That's right, Kaji should be able to give me
a clear answer on what happened to Mana.
translation: 没错，关于真名的遭遇，加持先生应该能给我明确的答案。

text: I need to sort out my feelings,
translation: 我得先理清自己的心情，

text: and not let anyone take advantage of me...
translation: 不能再被任何人牵着鼻子走了...

text: Forgetting Mana's misfortune...
I think it's just cruel.
But, she chose the pilot boy.
translation: 但是，她选择了那个驾驶员少年。

text: It wasn't about me.
I'll just forget it...
It's hard to throw away photos with people in them...
translation: 有人的照片...终究难以轻易丢弃啊

text: What are you looking at?
Asuka.
Hmmm...
Shinji, at the age of 14 you already became a man carrying a shadow.
translation: 真嗣君，14岁的你已然背负着阴影了呢。

text: I'm going to throw this picture away.

If you tear it and throw it from the roof,
the teacher will get mad at you.
translation:
要是撕碎从屋顶撒下去的话
老师会发火的哦

text: Wouldn't it be better to burn it?
Do you have matches or a lighter?
translation: 你有火柴或者打火机吗？

text: Excuse me, I don't smoke.
Mana loved lakes,
let's burn it at Lake Ashinoko.
translation: 我们就在芦之湖把它烧掉吧。

text:
It's all empty,
looks like we have it all to ourselves.
translation:
完全空无一人呢，
看来整片湖光山色都归我们独享了。

text: Don't you despise me, Asuka?
translation: 明日香，你其实很讨厌我吧？

text:
You were going to throw the photo away
because I came there, weren't you?
translation:
因为我的出现，
你当时才想把照片扔掉的吧？

text: It's because I want closure...
translation: 我只是想给往事画上句号...

text: You should forget about the past.
translation: 你应该把过去彻底遗忘。

text: You make it sound so easy...
About Kirishima,
I don't feel sorry for her at all.

Even if it was Eva's fault,
I don't feel bad about myself.
translation: 就算是EVA的错，我也不会责怪自己。

text: It's all cold, my heart.
Mana has...
disappeared...
And the pendant?
Eh...

Since it can't be burned,
should we throw it into the lake?
translation: 既然烧不掉，要不扔进湖里？

text:
Since it's a memento,
I need to send it to Mana's parents.
translation: 毕竟是遗物，得寄给真名的父母。

text: You don't know the address, do you?
But, throwing it away is...
You're not throwing it away, you're sinking it,
translation: 你这不是在丢弃它，而是在将其沉入心底，

text: you haven't come to terms with anything at all.
translation: 你根本就没能真正释怀。

text: Do you really even want to forget her?
You're no good, you know.
I'm going back, see you.
Wait! It's an expensive thing,

and since it's a memento, i'll have to
return it to her parents, it's important.
translation: 既然是遗物，我得把它还给她父母才行，这很重要。

text: Goodbye.
Ah! Asuka, I don't understand you!
translation: 啊！明日香，我完全搞不懂你！

text: It's over a hour until the next bus comes.
translation: 距离下一班巴士来还有一个多小时呢。

text: Are you telling me to walk home?
translation: 你的意思是要我走回家吗？

text: What are you so angry for?
If you hate the pendant so much, I can throw it away.
translation: 要是这么讨厌这个挂坠，我扔掉就是了。

text: It's too late for that now.
translation: 现在说这个已经太迟了。

text: See? I threw it away.
Pick it up!
Why?
Just pick it up!
Throw it away, pick it up...
here, I picked it back up.
You'll get all wet,
let's take some shelter from the rain.
translation: 我们先找个地方避避雨吧。

text: I don't want to...
Come on now.
What's wrong...
I'm keeping myself warm, so I don't catch a cold.
translation: 我在给自己保暖，免得感冒。

text: It'll be dry soon.
Be quiet...
The pirate ship sailing on this lake,
translation: 在这片湖上航行的海盗船，

text: It'll never sail through stormy seas, right?
translation: 它肯定没法在暴风雨的海面上航行吧？

text: You feel sorry for it?
I'm feeling good.
Well, should we get going back soon?
translation: 那个…我们差不多该回去了吧？

text: Yeah.
It's my first time on this train.
translation: 这是我第一次坐这班电车。

text: Somehow I'm kind of nervous,

unfamiliar landscapes, unfamiliar stations,
and the first time I ate at a soba stand.
translation:
陌生的风景，陌生的车站，
还有第一次在荞麦面摊吃饭的经历。

text: Everyone looks like a traveler on the express.
translation: 特快列车上的每个人都像是旅人。

text: Shinji Ikari, right?
...You have the wrong person.
I'm from NERV Headquarters.
I don't know, goodbye!
Hey there! Wait!
Excuse me.
Excuse me!
What is it, boy?
Are you fishermen?
Yeah, what is it? You wanna become a fisher?
The men of the sea don't need any part timers.
translation: 我们跑海的可不需要临时工。

text: No, ummm... you catch fish with nets, right?
translation: 那个，呃…你们是用渔网捕鱼的吧？

text:
What is it?
It'll be bothersome if you're not being clear.
translation:
什么事？
说话含糊不清会很麻烦的。

text:
Umm, did you happen to catch a life-capsule
with your nets?
translation: 嗯…你们用渔网的时候，有没有碰巧捞到一个生命胶囊？

text: Ah, you mean the one with that girl inside it?
translation: 啊，你说里面有个女孩的那个？

text: So, you found her!?

At first, we thought that it's a bomb
and it made a big fuzz,
translation: 起初我们还以为是炸弹，闹得沸沸扬扬的，

text:
but when we opened it, there was a girl inside.
She's at that hospital there right now.
translation:
但打开后才发现里面是个女孩。
她现在就在那边的医院里。

text: Mana...
Shinji!
I missed you.
You came for me. Thank you.
The other boy?
He didn't make it...
Mana, you need to stay strong.

You can't stay here, Shinji.
Scary people will come here soon.
translation:
不能待在这里了真嗣。
那些可怕的人很快就会追来。

text: Let's run away from here!
It's going to be bothersome.
I want to help you, Mana.
Shinji...
I want to save Mana.
So, she is alive after all?
I kidnapped her from a hospital.
translation: 我可是从医院把她偷出来的。

text:
Not bad! Bring her to my house,
I'll help you out.
translation:
干得不错！带她来我家吧，
我来帮你搞定。

text: Don't say anything to my father.
That goes without saying.
No one's here yet.
Shinji, can I use the shower?
translation: 真嗣，我能用下淋浴间吗？

text: Eh? Ah, sure.
Does this dryer dry clothes quickly?
translation: 这个烘干机干衣速度快吗？

text: Are you doing laundry?
My clothes are all dirty, so I want to wash all of them.
translation: 衣服全都弄脏了，我想全部洗一遍。

text: That's fine.
Can I borrow your bath towel?
Just wait a minute.
Don't look in here.
O-okay.
I don't understand how this washing machine works.
translation: 这洗衣机的操作方式我不太明白。

text: Just leave everything in it, and I'll take care of it.
translation: 东西放着就好，我来处理。

text: It's all dirty, so don't look inside.
I won't look.
Promise me!
I promise I won't look!
Ta-da~♪
...How was your shower?
Feels wonderful to be alive!
Your colors are looking a lot better now.
translation: 你的气色看起来好多了。

text: Yeah, I'm freshly boiled.
translation: 嗯，刚被热水煮过一遍呢。

text: ...Your towel is about to fall off.
Wanna see?
Eh..?
Tee~hee~hee~hee~
Umm...
I'm glad you're not injured.
Wanna check and make sure?

It's a miracle you made it
out of that explosion alive.
translation: 能从那种爆炸中活下来简直是奇迹。

text: I'm sorry for the trouble, everyone.
translation: 给大家添麻烦了，对不起。

text:
Everyone, it has to be kept an absolute secret
that Kirishima is here. Don't let anyone know.
translation: 雾岛在这里的事必须绝对保密，千万别让任何人知道。

text: I want to talk with Kaji about what to do next.
translation: 关于后续安排，我想和加持先生谈谈。

text: That guy?
Somehow, I have a feeling he'll be able to help...
translation: 不知为何，总觉得他能帮上忙……

text: What? You make it sound like we're not on your side.
translation: 什么意思？说得好像我们不是你这边的似的。

text:
Now now, Kaji seems to have some
free time, so why not?
translation: 好啦好啦，加持先生似乎有空，不如试试看？

text:
I don't have too much free time on my hands,
but I was getting a bit bored.
translation: 我虽然不算太闲，但确实有点无聊了呢。

text: Kaji~♪

It may sound a little harsh, but the fact that
you snuck out of the hospital is a problem.
translation: 话说得可能有点重，但你擅自逃出医院确实是个问题。

text:
If I hadn't gotten her out of there,
she might have gotten killed.
translation: 如果当时没带她离开，她可能已经没命了。

text:
From their point of view,
it's like you're the assassin, Shinji.
translation: 在那些人眼里，你才像是刺客哦，真嗣。

text: So then, what can we do to help her?
translation: 那么，我们现在能为她做些什么？

text: We need to kill Mana Kirishima.
translation: 我们需要杀死雾岛真名。

text: As expected from Kaji♪ That's extreme!
translation: 真不愧是加持先生♪这主意太极端啦！

text: Quit joking around!
Kill her...

Your name will be changed and you'll
live as a different person.
translation: 你的名字会被更改，将以另一个人的身份活下去。

text: We'll erase the name "Mana Kirishima" from the military register and the government's family register.
translation: 我们会将'雾岛真名'从军籍和政府的户籍中彻底抹除。

text:
It's all controlled by computers,
so it'll only take a second to do.
translation: 这些都是电脑控制的，只需要一秒钟就能完成。

text: What will happen to my father and mother?
translation: 那我的父亲和母亲会怎么样？

text: Unfortunately they'll become strangers to you.
translation: 很遗憾，他们将变成与你毫不相干的陌生人。

text:
That's the only way to keep on living
without hiding in the attic.
translation: 这是唯一能让你不必躲藏在阁楼里，继续活下去的方法。

text: But she will be saved, right?

However, this will be the last time
you'll be able to see her.
translation: 不过，这将是你最后一次见到她了。

text:
We can't have someone who disappeared
walking around the town, right?
translation: 总不能让一个已经消失的人还在镇上晃悠吧？

text: Shinji...
A faraway town no one knows...
translation: 一个无人知晓的遥远小镇...

text: Every town in Japan is listed on the map.
translation: 日本每个小镇都标注在地图上。

text: I'll live my life alone.
I cried so much at the hospital I feel all refreshed.
translation: 在医院哭得太厉害，现在反而觉得神清气爽。

text: Umm, you cried... for him too?
...Maybe.
Mana.
Hmm?
You're not the only one who'll be alone.
translation: 会变得孤身一人的...不止你一个。

text: Shinji...
Besides, it's not so bad being alone,
translation: 而且孤独也没那么糟糕，

text: it's because I was alone, that I was able to be with you.
translation: 正因为我曾经孤独，才能与你相遇。

text: So there's a good side to it, too.
translation: 所以这也有好的一面呢。

text: Thank you,
Shinji...
Farewell.
Yes, Kaji speaking.
Hello?
Is it Katsuragi?
It's Ikari, excuse me.
Oh, it's you, Shinji.
What is it? Are you in trouble?
Kaji...
I can't do this anymore.
Shinji.
Kaji, I'm sorry,
calling you up suddenly like this...
Hmm? Oh, it's fine, I'm free now anyway,
translation: 嗯？没事啦，反正我现在正好有空，

text: and I wanted to come see the school again.
translation: 也正好想再来学校看看。

text: School is nice, I wish I could go through it again.
translation: 校园真好啊，真想重新再当一次学生呢。

text: Studying is kinda boring.
translation: 不过读书什么的还是挺无聊的。

text: It's never boring with this many friends around, right?
translation: 有这么多朋友在身边，总不会无聊吧？

text: I'm always alone,
so I have nothing to do...
I'll listen to your worries,
tell me.
It's about Kirishima.
That girl...
I need to sort out my feelings.
translation: 我需要理清自己的心情。

text: I need to accept her fate,

and if I hear it from you,
I think I'll be able to move on.
translation:
如果由你亲口告诉我，
我想我就能继续前进了。

text: I see...
What do you want to do, Shinji?
Could it be...?
She's alive.
Really!?

The life-capsule was recovered from
the ocean by a fishing boat.
translation: 生命维持舱是被渔船从海里打捞上来的。

text: However, only a few people are aware of it.
translation: 不过知道这件事的人很少。

text: She's destined for a new life in a new town.
translation: 她将在新的城镇开始新的人生。

text: Can I meet her?
Do you want to?
I want to see her.

It will be a one-time opportunity.
Can you leave school early?
translation:
这可是千载难逢的机会。
能提前离校吗？

text: I can.
Alright. Don't let anyone else know about this.
translation: 好吧。别让其他人知道这件事。

text: Teacher, I'll be leaving early.
Is that so? You're always doing your best protecting peace on Earth.
translation: 是吗？你一直都很努力地守护着地球的和平呢。

text: What is it today?
It's a life-saving operation.
I see. Human life is precious indeed.
translation: 明白了。人类的生命确实珍贵。

text: Go on, then.
Okay.
He's a good teacher, it's a bit hard for me.
translation: 他是个好老师，只是对我来说有点难相处。

text:
There's nothing more important in the world
than meeting with your lover.
translation: 这世上再没什么比与恋人相会更重要的事了。

text: A lie is a lie, though...
You're kind, Shinji...
A good man.
Idiot Shinji!!
Asuka!?
If you go meet that girl, I'm done with you!
translation: 你要是敢去见那个女孩，我就跟你绝交！

text:
I'm going to meet with Mana,
but I have no intention to cut you off!
translation: 我是要去见真名，但根本没打算和你断绝关系！

text: You really are in love with me!
I don't know about that!
Idiot! Pervert! Enemy of women!
Yes, this is Kaji.
You! Don't drag Shinji into this anymore.
I'm not doing anything.

You're taking him to see her, aren't you?
Stop it, it's dangerous!
translation:
你要带他去见她吧？
快住手，这太危险了！

text:
It's going to get complicated when the military
gets involved! You know that, right!?
translation:
要是军方介入事情会变得很复杂！
你明明知道的吧！？

text: I have no idea what you're talking about, I'm hanging up.
translation: 我不知道你在说什么，我要挂电话了。

text: I'm going to ram his car off a cliff.
translation: 我要把他的车撞下悬崖。

text: Shit, I'm not letting you scratch it.
translation: 可恶，我可不会让你碰到它分毫。

text:
You ignore all my usual invitations,
and now you're chasing me like this.
translation: 平时我邀你多少次都不理不睬，现在却这样穷追不舍。

text: Your behavior always pisses me off.
translation: 你这副做派总是让我火大。

text:
It'll be all over soon,
can't you just be quiet and watch?
translation: 马上就要结束了，你就不能安静看着吗？

text: Kaji,
you might like being the lone wolf,
translation: 你或许享受独来独往的潇洒，

text: but don't push your lifestyle on Shinji.
translation: 但别把这种生存方式强加给真嗣。

text:
Katsuragi, if you're going to interfere
with this, take Asuka home right now.
translation: 葛城，要是想插手这事，现在就带明日香回家。

text: I work for NERV, and I'm taking Shinji with me.
translation: 我是NERV的人，真嗣必须跟我走。

text: If I do this, it'll all become my responsibility.
translation: 若我动手，一切后果都将由我承担。

text: You're always like this,
Selfish! And pushy!
That's how you always take everything away from me.
translation: 你总是这样从我身边夺走一切。

text: Give Shinji back to me!
Why don't you just shoot me with that gun?
translation: 你干脆用那把枪打死我算了？

text: How about a drink on the way back?
translation: 回去路上喝一杯怎么样？

text:
There's an Italian restaurant on the way
that serves tons of pasta.
translation:
途中有家意大利餐厅
供应超多种类的意面。

text: Don't try to distract me...
It's time.
Someone's coming this way.
Mana.
Shinji,
you were saved.
I'm glad.
Kaji.
Hmm?
Thank you very much.
Sure.
Misato.
I'm sorry.
It's okay, now.
I'm sorry.

No need to thank me,
just go and have a good look at the view.
translation:
不用谢我，
好好欣赏眼前的景色吧。

text: You don't have much time, right?
Asuka.
It's been a while.
I'm borrowing Shinji for a while.
Take him home with you, if you want.
When we saw you,
it was probably Misato who was most relieved.
translation: 最感到安心的，大概就是美里小姐了吧。

text: She's a nice woman, isn't she?
It's my fault, I'm always causing her trouble.
translation: 都怪我，总是给她添麻烦。

text: ...probably responsible for that.
I didn't mean it like that.
It's okay,

It's not really something I can
just solve with an apology.
translation: 这可不是光靠道歉就能解决的事。

text: I'm going to atone for what I've done.
translation: 我要为自己做过的事赎罪。

text: Mana Kirishima will disappear from this world.
translation: 雾岛真名将从这个世界消失。

text:
I'm getting a new name, living in a new room,
and go to a new school,
translation:
我会用新的名字，住进新的房间，
转入新的学校，

text: in a faraway town no one knows about.
translation: 在一个无人知晓的遥远小镇。

text: I'll really never get to see you again, right?
translation: 真的再也见不到你了吧？

text: Some day...
Some day I'll come to you.
translation: 总有一天我会去到你身边。

text: ...I'll be waiting.
Hey, Shinji, did you see the explosion incident last night?
translation: 喂，真嗣，你看到昨晚的爆炸事件了吗？

text: It was so impressive!
The shoe rack stinks.
Why are the girl's shoes so small?
translation: 为什么那个女孩的鞋子这么小？

text: I need to hurry to the class, or I'll be late.
translation: 我得赶紧去上课，不然要迟到了。

text: Wroooooom!
Bang!Bang!Bang!Bang!
Gyaaaan!
BOOM!
Gyooooon!
If I don't hurry, I'll be late.
translation: 如果我不赶紧，就要迟到了。

text:
If I run in the hallway, the teacher will get mad at me,
so I won't do it.
translation: 如果我在走廊上跑步，老师会生我的气，所以我不跑。

text: Let's hurry to the classroom.
I don't like to exercise.
translation: 我其实不太喜欢运动啦。

text: But I like the tennis court at morning, it has a nice feeling.
translation: 不过清晨的网球场倒是让人心情舒畅呢。

text: Maybe I'll be a little cooler if I join the tennis club, too.
translation: 要是加入网球社的话，说不定会变得帅气一点？

text: Let's hurry to the class, or I'll be late.
translation: 得赶紧去教室了，迟到可就糟了。

text: I'm preparing the spinach for tomorrow's class.
translation: 正在为明天的家政课准备菠菜哦。

text: Last night's incident?
It was so scary it made my stomach hurt.
translation: 可怕到让人胃都揪起来了呢。

text: It's just the usual home economics room.
translation: 明明只是平常的家政教室而已。

text:
Entering empty classrooms
makes me nervous for some reason.
translation: 不知为什么，空无一人的教室总让我心慌。

text: Is there still spinach in the fridge?
translation: 冰箱里还有剩下的菠菜吗？

text: If I don't hurry to the class, I'll be late.
translation: 再不快点去教室就要迟到了。

text: A new classmate is transferring to the school today.
translation: 今天会有转校生来我们班。

text: Let's get along.
Wha? Transfer student?
Guess I'm goin' to say hello.
I came to this city because my father asked me to.
translation: 我来这座城市是因为父亲的安排。

text: He called me here to pilot the Evangelion.
It wasn't a father-and-son kind of encounter.
translation: 那根本算不上父子重逢的场面。

text: Let's hurry to the classroom.
'ey, Shinji...
Why's da sky blue...
translation: 为什么天空是蓝色的啊……

text: Oh, it's you.
Do you like books?

There are old books that survived the Second Impact
and weren't burned.
translation: 这些是第二次冲击后幸存下来没被烧掉的旧书。

text:
Before I was born, there was a catastrophe
called The Second Impact.
translation: 在我出生之前，发生过一场叫做第二次冲击的灾难。

text: Half of humanity perished in it, I've heard.
