This lipstick isn't supposed to come off,
but looks like it still does.
translation: 这口红明明说是不会掉的，结果还是褪色了呢。

text: Wah, the demon's clawmarks on my pure white shirt...
translation: 哇啊，恶魔的爪印留在我纯白的衬衫上了...

text: I bought you a new shirt, so forgive me.
translation: 我给你买了新衬衫，原谅我吧。

text: I bought this with my own money, you know...
translation: 这可是我用自己零花钱买的哦...

text: But you chose it together with lady Asuka, didn't you?
translation: 但这是你和明日香小姐一起选的吧？

text: There's nothing to choose from with white shirts...
translation: 白衬衫根本没什么可挑的嘛...

text: What are you mumbling about now?
Oh, look!
Rei Ayanami.
Are you interested in that type of girls, too?
translation: 你对那种类型的女孩子也感兴趣吗？

text: I think it's normal to care about your friends.
translation: 我觉得关心朋友是很正常的事。

text: Stop playing dumb.
What?
A girl who is always quiet and lonely, eh?
translation: 哼，总是安静又孤僻的女生是吧？

text: Yeah......
So you are interested after all.
translation: 果然你还是会在意的嘛。

text: There's nothing wrong with thinking about others.
translation: 为别人着想又没什么错。

text: I thought you liked spending time with her?
translation: 我以为你很享受和她在一起的时光呢？

text: You're always like that Asuka, prying about things.
translation: 明日香你总是这样，什么事都要刨根问底。

text: What do you mean?

When I look at Ayanami,
it makes me want to try my best, too.
translation:
看着绫波丽的时候，
连我也会忍不住想要努力呢。

text: We're always fighting together.
It's something like a soul I can relate to, I guess.
translation: 大概就像是……能产生共鸣的灵魂之类的吧。

text: Hmph.
Ayanami!
Ikari.
Are you coming from NERV?
That doesn't concern you.
I see......
Everyone has their own lives, right?
translation: 每个人都有自己的生活，对吧？

text: What kind of books do you usually read, Ayanami?
translation: 绫波平时都看什么书呢？

text: Is it necessary to tell you?
It's dangerous to walk around while reading.
Don't worry about it.
Hey, Shinji, let's go.
Be quiet, Asuka.
Uuu~

You must have had
a special synchronization test or something,
translation: 你该不会是刚做完特规同步测试吧，

text:
since you're still in school uniform
at this time of the day.
It was Pribnow box repairs.
Could that be the one I broke, eh?
translation: 该不会是我弄坏的那个吧？

text: That's right.
I'm sorry.
Why do you apologize?
Well...... That's why... Umm, I...
Ah! Geez, I've had enough!
Ayanami is always entrusted with things by my father...
translation: 绫波总是被我父亲托付各种事情...

text: Working hard until sunset, carrying out orders.
translation: 工作到日落时分，执行着各种指令。

text:
On the other hand,
we have a lot of free time to hang out like this...
translation:
相比之下
我们却像这样悠闲地消磨时间...

text: Don't compare me to yourself.
This is the first time I've had a drink like this...
translation: 像这样喝酒还是第一次...

text: What do you think? Is it any good?
translation: 你觉得怎么样？味道还行吗？

text: It's so-so...
I see, thank goodness.
You care so much of the First Lady's company, Shinji.
translation: 真嗣君对第一夫人的陪伴还真是上心呢。

text: Or so it seems.
There you go again with that, Asuka.
You're so bad with girls I just set you up,
translation: 谁让你这么不擅长和女孩子相处

text: since you didn't do it yourself.
translation: 我只好替犹豫不决的你推一把咯。

text: I just wanted to talk as friends.
translation: 我只是想以朋友的身份聊聊天。

text: Friends......

On the other hand,
Shinji and I are more than friends, but not quite lovers.
translation:
不过话说回来，
真嗣和我的关系嘛，算是超越朋友却未达恋人的微妙状态。

text:
Shinji is such a weakling though,
so I have to do everything.
translation:
但真嗣实在太不可靠了，
什么事都得由我来主导。

text: Ikari is weak...?
Yep, that's right.
Asuka is always messing with me like this.
translation: 明日香总是这样捉弄我。

text: Ikari.
Yes?
Stay strong.
Listen to this, maybe it's because he's at that age,
translation: 跟你说哦，可能因为他正值青春期，

text: but he keeps looking and touching me.
translation: 总是偷瞄我还动手动脚的。

text:
That was a misunderstanding.
You're just teasing me again, Asuka.
translation:
那是误会。
你又在戏弄我了吧，明日香。

text:
The other day he saw my butt
and I kicked him by reflex.
translation:
前几天他偷看我屁股，
我下意识就踹了他一脚。

text: Oh, geez! This is so awkward.
translation: 呜哇！这气氛也太尴尬了吧。

text: I will report everything to Commander Ikari.
translation: 我会把一切都汇报给碇司令。

text: Wha-?
The juice is very tasty.
Don't tell my father. I'll be more careful from now on.
translation: 别告诉我父亲...我以后会注意的。

text: Are you listening?
Oh yeah, these are on your treat.
translation: 啊对了，这些算你请客哦。

text: Huh?

Isn't it nice, two beauties
on either side of the gentleman.
translation: 左右相伴两位美人，这位先生可真幸福呢。

text:
What a perfect chance
to show the princess what a man you are.
translation: 这可是向公主殿下展现男子气概的绝佳机会呢。

text:
After buying a new shirt,
and paying for these fancy tropical drinks...
translation: 买了新衬衫，又付了这些花哨的热带饮品钱...

text:
Shopping sprees like this are harsh
on junior high school student's wallet.
translation: 这种购物狂欢对初中生的钱包来说可真够呛。

text: It's fine. I'll pay for my own share.
translation: 没关系，我付自己那份就好。

text: It's been a while everyone!
Kirishima!

Wha! "It's been a while"?
You just transferred here this morning.
translation: 哇！"好久不见"？你明明今天早上才转学过来的。

text: Shinji, nice timing. Let's go home together!
translation: 真嗣，来得正好。我们一起回家吧！

text: Eh?
Shinji is coming home with me!
Well, then I'll come with you.
We have things to do, so get lost!
translation: 我们还有事要办，快闪开啦！

text: How about until the elevators then?
translation: 那至少送到电梯口如何？

text: Why do you keep following us!?
translation: 你为什么一直跟着我们啊！？

text: Calm down!

Yo, everyone!
Ya all havin' a drink? Da teacher will get mad at ya!
translation:
哟各位！
都在喝酒？老师知道了要发火哦！

text: Toji!
I just came here following Asuka's voice.
translation: 我只是顺着明日香的声音找过来的。

text: This isn't the festival area, you know.
translation: 这里可不是庆典会场啊。

text:
So, since Kirishima's here,
let's have a welcome party for da transfer student.
translation: 既然雾岛同学今天转学过来，我们开个欢迎派对吧！

text: Nice to meet you all!

You should have invited us, too,
if it's a welcome party!
translation: 既然是欢迎会，也该叫上我们嘛！

text:
Wait!
We were just sitting here drinking juice, and then...
translation: 等等！我们只是刚好坐在这里喝果汁...

text: I came here to see Shinji.
What the hell is with that!?
That's not true!
I'm so jealous! Why's everyone always after ya?
translation: 太让人羡慕了吧！为什么大家都围着你转啊？

text: Shinji Ikari. The man having sweet drinks with beautiful girls in the afternoon.
translation: 碇真嗣。这个在午后与美少女共饮甜饮的男人。

text:
Eating and sleeping under the same roof
with Misato and Asuka.
translation: 不仅和美里、明日香同吃同住

text: What a way to live, oh, the envy...
translation: 多么令人艳羡的活法啊……

text:
Jealousy doesn't kill people...
but why must it hurt so much... Argh...
translation: 嫉妒虽不致命……可这份刺痛为何如此难熬……呜……

text: GIVE ME BACK MY YOUTH!!
I'm leaving......
Shinji, do you live together with Asuka?
translation: 真嗣，你和明日香是同居状态吗？

text:
Uhh, Kirishima,
we live in the same house, but we have our separate rooms.
translation: 呃、雾岛同学，我们虽然同住一栋房子，但房间是分开的。

text: We're not together.
Our rooms are separate, but our hearts are one!
translation: 房间是分开的，但我们的心紧紧相连！

text: Is da bath separate too?
Eh? There's just one, but...
Disgusting! That's too disgusting!
We bathe separately, obviously!
translation: 我们当然是分开洗的啊！

text: All right! Ye still have a chance, Kirishima!
Do yer best!
Toji! Wait for me! I'll do my best, too!
translation: 冬二！等我！我也要全力以赴！

text: I'll see you later.
See you tomorrow.
Wait, what! What the hell was that...
What does that girl mean to you?
translation: 那个女孩对你来说意味着什么？

text:
What's this all of a sudden?
Hurry up and take off your shoes.
translation:
突然说这个干嘛？
快把鞋子脱掉。

text: That's the kind of girl you want?
translation: 原来你喜欢那种类型的女孩子？

text:
I was thinking,
this is probably what put you in such a bad mood
on the train ride back home.
translation: 这大概就是你回家路上一直黑着脸的原因吧

text: Me or that girl. Which one is it?
translation: 是我还是那女孩？到底哪个惹到你了？

text: Again with the comparison...
I'm prettier than her, right?
translation: 明明我比她可爱多了，对吧？

text: I wonder what Kaji would do in situations like this...
translation: 这种时候...加持先生会怎么做呢...

text: How would he respond...
Tell me I'm cute.
...Asuka.
You're a man, right?
Hey, just tell me I'm cute.
Man...
I'll teach you how it's done.
...You're cute.
Say it more manly.
You're cute. You're the cutest, Asuka.
translation: 你最可爱了。世界第一可爱的明日香。

text: Say it again.

You're the cutest girl in the world, in the solar system.
The cutest girl in the whole galaxy.
translation:
你是银河系最可爱的女孩
太阳系第一的小公主

text:
In the entire universe.
You're even cuter than space aliens.
translation:
全宇宙最可爱
连外星人都没你迷人

text: Stop messing around.
...What do you think about me, Asuka?
Are you making me say it?
translation: 非要让我亲口说出来吗？

text: I won't say I love you.

That's not what I asked.
You're just overconfident, Asuka.
translation:
我问的不是这个。
你只是太自以为是了，明日香。

text: You're just one of many men, Shinji,
translation: 你不过是众多男人中的一个，真嗣，

text: that's why you should be the one to say it.
So, you do recognize me as man.
translation: 所以，你确实承认我是个男人了。

text: What?
What about it?
It's fine. I'll forgive you.
translation: 没关系哦，我会原谅你的。

text:
I wonder if the occasional affection
she shows me is her real feelings as a girl,
translation: 她偶尔流露出的温柔，究竟是少女真心的体现，

text:
or is it just habits she picked up
living in a foreign country.
translation: 还是异国生活养成的习惯使然呢？

text:
Asuka, you like more grown-up men?
Like Kaji, right?
translation: 明日香，你喜欢更成熟的男性吧？比如加持先生？

text: Obviously.
Hey, let's switch to a more interesting channel.
translation: 喂，换个有意思的频道啦。

text: There's only 10 minutes left.
Why though? This is stupid.
Aah! Don't look at me! I'm drying my hair.
translation: 啊！别看我！我在吹头发呢。

text: Come on, hurry up and put some clothes on.

If you're looking at my body again,
I'll kick you as hard as I can.
translation: 要是再敢偷看我的身体，我就用尽全力踹飞你。

text: No one wants to see you naked, Asuka.
translation: 才没人想看你光着身子呢，明日香。

text: Oww! You threw a cup at me...
Whoa, blood! You broke my forehead!
translation: 哇啊流血了！我额头都被你砸破了！

text: It's dangerous to throw things around, you know!
translation: 乱扔东西很危险的知不知道！

text: That's why I told you not to look!
What's the big deal, you're wearing a bath towel!
translation: 有什么好在意的，你不是裹着浴巾嘛！

text: Stop looking!
Wah! I'm sorry.
We're soldiers, right?

We're pilots. We just need to
focus on controlling the machine.
translation: 我们是驾驶员。只需要专注操控机体就好。

text:
But that machine, it's designed for
killing people.
translation: 但那台机器...根本就是为了杀人而设计的。

text: I know that, but it hasn't been decided if it's used yet.
translation: 我知道，但还没确定是否真要投入使用。

text:
If you have a car, you'd want to drive it.
If you had a gun, you'd want to shoot it.
translation: 就像有车就会想开，有枪就会想射击。

text:
If you have a weapon like that,
you'd eventually want to use it.
translation: 拥有那种武器的话，迟早会产生使用的冲动。

text:
You're right.
Maybe I'll just quit my pilot training before that, then.
translation: 说得对...看来我得在那之前退出驾驶员训练了。

text:
Climbing over the barbed wire fence with
your bare hands to escape sounds good.
translation: 徒手翻过带刺的铁丝网逃亡好像也不错。

text: I'm going to transfer to the information department.
translation: 我打算申请转调到情报部。

text:
What's this?
Why would you hide a big thing like that for?
translation: 这是什么？为什么要藏这么大的东西？

text: The military has a lot of secrets.
translation: 军方可是藏着不少秘密呢。

text: When will you move?

Actually, an intelligence program is going to start.
A spy operation.
translation:
其实马上要启动情报计划了——
一次间谍行动。

text: The stuff where you hang in mid-air by wire action?
translation: 就是那种用钢丝吊在半空的特工把戏？

text: Don't tell anyone about it.
translation: 这件事可别告诉任何人哦。

text:
What will you do if an enemy soldier
comes at you with a gun?
translation:
要是敌兵端着枪冲过来，
你准备怎么办？

text:
I've seen it in a movie,
but you can't see enemy soldiers from here.
translation:
我在电影里见过这种场面，
不过从这里根本看不到敌兵啦。

text: I'd shoot them on sight. I don't want to lose.
translation: 见一个毙一个，我可不想输。

text: My destination is a junior high school classroom.
translation: 我的目的地是初中教室。

text: Switching your weapon to a pen, you mean?
translation: 意思是要把武器换成钢笔吗？

text: Look.
These two large rocks are father and mother.
translation: 这两块大石头是爸爸和妈妈。

text: This small one is a child.

The father goes off to serve in the army,
leaving the mother and the child behind.
translation: 爸爸离家参军去了，留下妈妈和孩子。

text: If he were to get shot down by this weapon...
translation: 要是他被这种武器击落的话……

text: The mother and the child would surely feel lonely.
translation: 妈妈和孩子一定会很寂寞吧。

text: That's the kind of stuff I hate.

The man could be single,
or maybe the weapon is unmanned.
translation: 说不定那男人是单身汉，又或者武器是无人驾驶的。

text: You can't really know things like that, can you?
translation: 这种事情根本没法确定不是吗？

text: If there's people onboard, you can tell it.
translation: 如果上面有人，你是能感觉到的。

text: I wouldn't know.
You'll understand it when you see it.
translation: 等你亲眼见到就会明白了。

text: If I'd hesitate to shoot a gun and get shot instead, would you be fine with that?
translation: 要是我犹豫着不敢开枪反被打中，你能接受吗？

text: That's...

I get what you're trying to say though.
Life's the most important thing, I think so too.
translation:
不过我能理解你想表达的意思。
生命才是最珍贵的，这点我也深有同感。

text: Musashi!
Keita! Did you buy the canned juice?
translation: 圭太！罐装果汁买来了吗？

text:
The instructor is pretty angry.
He's been looking for us using the recon satellite.
translation:
教官正在大发雷霆呢。
连侦察卫星都用上在找我们了。

text: Shit, we should hurry back.
Huh? Did you make Mana cry again?
translation: 咦？你又把真那弄哭了吗？

text: I'm not crying.
Hurry up, let's run!
Wait up, what about the juice!?

I guess this is the last time I see you
in a piloting uniform, eh?
translation: 这大概是我最后一次见你穿驾驶服了吧？

text: I'm fine with that.

Gross weight of 3,000 tons,
100,000 horsepower turbojet engines.
translation: 总重三千吨，搭载十万马力的涡轮喷气引擎。

text:
It can run on land, climb up mountains
and soar the skies like a bird.
translation: 能在陆上奔驰，能攀越山岭，还能如飞鸟般翱翔天际。

text:
It can even be a submarine if submerged, and
it operates for seven days with a tank of fuel.
translation: 潜入水中能当潜艇用，加满一次燃料可连续运作七天。

text: It takes a lot of fuel to run this thing, don't you think?
translation: 开动这家伙很耗燃料吧？

text: It feels quite wasteful.

Is there a specific reason why you
decided to quit piloting?
translation: 你决定不再驾驶EVA，是有什么特别的理由吗？

text: Somehow, it just feels like what we're doing is wrong...
translation: 总觉得...我们正在做的事情不太对劲...

text: Don't tell anyone else about what I just said, though.
translation: 不过刚才这些话，可别告诉其他人哦。

text:
With one of these machines,
we could build a whole new country.
translation: 只要拥有这种机甲，我们甚至能建立全新的国度。

text: What do you mean by that?

We could ride it to the southern island,
and from that day onwards,
translation: 驾驶它前往南方岛屿，从那天起——

text:
declare it our country!
And if anyone comes to interfere...
translation: 就宣告那是我们的领土！要是有人敢来插手...

text: This Raiden will beat them up.
translation: 这台雷电能揍扁所有碍事的家伙。

text:
Aah~♪ What a dreamlike story.
Are you planning on writing science fiction in the future?
translation: 啊~♪ 真是梦幻般的构想呢。你将来是打算写科幻小说吗？

text: I'm being serious, that's how countries are born.
translation: 我是认真的，历史上所有国家都是这样诞生的啊。

text: You'll be the president then.
You will be the queen, since I'm making it a kingdom.
translation: 既然我要建立王国，你就当女王好了。

text: Hehe~♪ The pricess of the south island.
translation: 呵呵~♪ 南国岛屿的公主殿下。

text: We'll build a paradise with our own hands.
translation: 我们要亲手打造属于我们的乐园。

text: I like how that sounds.
translation: 这个说法听起来真不错呢。

text:
It's a nice story, isn't it?
But it's a secret just between the two of us.
translation:
很美好的故事对吧？
不过这是只属于我们两个人的秘密哦。

text: Mana!
Keita.

Keita's lunch: a mountain of rice,
pilaf, a large bowl of meatballs,
translation:
庆太的午餐：堆成小山的米饭、
肉酱烩饭、超大份的肉丸，

text:
shredded cabbage that overflows the plate,
and heaps of sauce.
translation:
多到快溢出来的卷心菜丝，
还有淋得满满的酱汁。

text: Don't you think that's a bit too much?
translation: 你不觉得这有点过分了吗？

text: It'll be good for training to eat this much!
translation: 吃这么多对训练有好处啦！

text:
It's dinner for sure.
Do you plan to eat until tomorrow?
translation:
这绝对是晚餐的量吧。
你打算一直吃到明天吗？

text: Well, it's better to sleep with a full stomach, right?
translation: 哎呀，吃饱了才好睡觉嘛，对吧？

text:
Just like Mana said...
~munch munch munch~
translation:
真像真名说的那样...
~吧唧吧唧吧唧~

text: Just don't bring donuts into the barracks.
translation: 只要别把甜甜圈带进营房就行。

text: I'm talking about the food we're loading in Raiden,
translation: 我说的是往雷登号里装的食物，

text:
it's type-5 combat-rations,
which are basically sets of boiled rice,
translation:
是第五型战斗口粮，
其实就是盒装的白米饭套餐，

text:
mixed with fish and vegetables,
packed into cardboard boxes.
translation:
混着鱼肉和蔬菜，
塞在硬纸盒里的那种。

text:
How much are you gonna eat? How many boxes
are we stacking? Do you want red rice too?
translation:
你要吃多少？我们得堆多少盒？
要不要连红小豆饭也带上？

text:
Hey, Keita, keep your voice down,
that conversation is...
translation:
喂，景太，小声点啦——
那个计划的话题...

text: Eh? What conversation?
The one where we escape here and build a new country.
translation: 就是逃离这里去建立新国度的事啊。

text: Stop it!
Escape? You were serious!?

Yeah.
We've been planning the revolution for a month now.
translation:
当然。
我们策划这场革命已经一个月了。

text:
The three of us will set up a government
and even create a manifesto.
translation:
我们三人要组建政府
连宣言书都拟好了。

text: That's just a pipe dream, you know!
What was that?

It was a lie! It's just a dream we have
to help us get through living here.
translation:
都是骗人的！不过是
支撑我们活下去的幻想罢了

text: That's...
Besides, Mana doesn't want to pilot anymore,
translation: 而且真名已经不想再驾驶了，

text:
she thinks the killing machines are better off
at the bottom of the ocean.
translation: 她觉得那些杀戮机器沉在海底反而更好。

text:
Stop it. This isn't something to
talk about over the dinner.
translation: 别说了。这种事不该在饭桌上讨论。

text: So it was all a lie?
translation: 所以这一切都是谎言吗？

text:
And Keita, you need to calm down,
people are watching you again.
translation: 还有景太，你冷静点，大家又在盯着你了。

text: Musashi, you're a traitor. I believed in you.
translation: 武藏，你这个叛徒。我明明那么信任你。

text:
Musashi, you idiot! And I hate you too, Mana!
Waaah~
translation: 武藏你个笨蛋！真名我也讨厌你！呜哇~

text: Keita!
That Keita...
It's tough......
Keita.
Keita, about what I said earlier...
translation: 景太，关于刚才我说的话……

text: It hurts......
What did you say?
It hurts.
Ah! Your face is full of bruises!
Who did this to you?
It's okay......
No it's not!
Tell me who did this.
It's all your fault, Musashi.

You were supposed to take Raiden and defect,
but you got scared and quit.
translation:
你本该带着雷电一起叛逃的，
结果却因为害怕临阵退缩了。

text: That's why I'm being bullied by everyone, right?
translation: 所以我现在才会被大家欺负，对吧？

text: We'll show the adults.
translation: 我们要给大人们点颜色看看。

text: Are we doing it?
What are you planning to do, Musashi?

I'm gonna go wild outside the fence,
and it's going to feel good!
translation:
我要在围墙外大闹一场，
那感觉一定超痛快！

text: Hooray! Way to go, Musashi!
Stop that!
Musashi.
I wish we could have been together sooner...
translation: 要是我们能更早相遇就好了……

text: It's my fault that Mana is gone.....
translation: 真名会消失……都是我的错……

text:
I loved her so much.....
Why did she have to go and disappear?
translation:
我明明那么爱她……
为什么她非要消失不可呢？

text: Shinji, you've already had 13 cups of coffee,
translation: 真嗣，这已经是第13杯咖啡了

text: you're going to wreck your body.
Another one, please.
How can you be that drunk on coffee?
translation: 你怎么能喝咖啡喝到神志不清啊？

text: 14th cup, please.
This'll be the last one.

It's so strange......
Feels like your voice has changed, Mr.Toku.
translation:
好奇怪啊......
总觉得德先生的声音变了呢。

text:
It hasn't! You must be imagining things.
What are you even saying?
translation:
才没有！肯定是你的错觉啦。
在胡说些什么呀？

text: Even though you always come to the store.
translation: 明明你总是来店里光顾的。

text:
Even though I was saved by Asuka,
I have a feeling inside...
translation:
虽然被明日香所救，
但心里却有种莫名的悸动...

text: I find myself thinking about Mana.
translation: 脑海中总是浮现真名的身影。

text: That's the beginning of love.
I want to believe that Mana is still alive.
translation: 我愿意相信真名还活着。

text: A man's heart torn between loyalty and humanity is making me cry.
translation: 忠诚与人性在男人心中撕扯，让我不禁落泪。

text: I feel bad for Asuka, but my memories of Mana...
translation: 对明日香感到愧疚，但关于真名的记忆...

text: ...they torment me.
You're so popular, Shinji. I'm jealous.
translation: 真嗣君真是受欢迎呢，我都有些嫉妒了。

text: Am I wrong!?

You shouldn't be asking from me,
it's troublesome.
translation: 这种事不该来问我啊，太麻烦了。

text:
I couldn't even save a single girl,
I'm such a useless man.
translation: 连一个女孩都救不了，我真是个没用的男人。

text:
People always end up getting hurt
when meeting a person like this.
translation: 遇到像我这样的人，大家最后总会受伤。

text:
The Earth is burning, and saving the world,
but not even being able to save the one I love...
translation: 明明在拯救燃烧的地球，却连心爱之人都无法守护...

text: I was never up to this.
Shinji, it's me.
Mana's voice...?
You're all wet from the rain.
translation: 你全身都被雨淋湿了呢。

text: Mana! You were saved!?
No one knows I'm here, if anyone gets suspicious, I'll get taken again.
translation: 没人知道我在这里，要是有人起疑心，我又会被抓走的。

text: Thank goodness, I'm so happy you're alive!
translation: 谢天呐，你还活着真是太好了！

text:
You need your clothes washed and dried,
come with me for a bit.
translation: 你的衣服需要洗烘，跟我来一下。

text: Getting my clothes dried is fine, but this place...
translation: 烘干衣服是没问题啦，但这地方...

text:
Isn't it a little perverted to just
wear a towel over my bare skin like this?
translation: 像这样只裹着毛巾贴身穿，是不是有点变态啊？

text:
What are you saying? You're still
wearing something underneath, right?
translation: 说什么呢？你里面应该还穿着别的吧？

text: Eh? These?
Take it all off!
I'll be seen naked!
Hurry up! Wet underwear is disgusting.
translation: 快点！湿漉漉的内衣穿着超难受的。

text: ...They could be dirty.
Then, take them off so I can wash them.
Doing this in front of a girl is not cool.
translation: 在女孩子面前这样可不太得体哦。

text: You're a man, move with some enthusiasm!
translation: 你可是男生，动作干脆利落点！

text: Uhh, okay, I get it.
The clothes I'm wearing, are these yours?
translation: 我身上这件衣服，是你的吗？

text: They're cute, aren't they?
They're perfect size for my body.
translation: 尺寸和我身材完美契合呢。

text: I'm glad you're okay, Shinji.

At the time of that disaster,
I couldn't do anything to save you,
translation:
那场灾难发生时，
我却没能为你做任何事，

text: I just stood there watching, petrified.
translation:
只是呆立原地，
浑身僵硬地注视着一切。

text:
It's okay. At that time,
I was only thinking about Musashi.
translation:
没关系的。那时候，
我满脑子只想着武藏的事。

text: That boy saved your life, didn't he?
translation: 是那个男孩救了你的命吧？

text: Musashi put me into the life-capsule, nothing more.
translation: 武藏只是把我塞进了救生舱而已。

text:
He's a brave soldier.
I wish I could do something like that.
translation:
他真是个勇敢的战士呢。
真希望我也能像他那样。

text: How did you survive?
Asuka saved me. That's why, I owe her for that.
translation:
是明日香救了我。
所以，我欠她一条命。

text: You really like Asuka, don't you?
translation: 你其实很喜欢明日香吧？

text:
It's just you and me here,
why are we even talking about this?
translation:
现在只有我们两个人，
怎么突然说起这个？

text: If it had been just you and me at that time,
translation: 如果那时候只有你和我两个人，

text: you would have tried to save me, right?
translation: 你应该会想办法救我的吧？

text: Of course. I would have done everything I can.
I should have been able to do something.
translation: 我明明应该能做点什么的。

text:
At that time,
if only Unit-01's power wouldn't have ran out...
translation:
那时候
要是初号机的能量没有耗尽的话……

text:
Of course, it's true that we were able to
escape because Unit-02 was there,
translation:
确实，因为二号机在场
我们才能逃脱，

text: but, I couldn't imagine it happened that way.
translation: 但是，我实在无法想象事情会变成那样。

text:
When you left me, I just stood there,
shocked and surprised.
translation:
当你抛下我离开时，我只是呆立在原地
震惊得不知所措。

text: Now it just sounds like I'm making excuses.
translation: 现在听起来就像我在找借口一样。

text: I'm just getting less and less confident,
translation: 我只是越来越没有自信了

text: maybe I am a hopeless person after all.
translation: 或许我终究是个无可救药的人吧。

text: Hopeless is just fine.
Eh?
A hug?

I'm not letting go of you,
I don't want to lose anyone ever again.
translation:
我不会放开你的，
再也不想失去任何人了。

text: Your body feels so hot...
You can feel the beating on my chest, right?
translation: 能感受到我胸口的跳动吧？

text: Your heart?
Place your hand on my chest.
I can feel it very faintly.
...I've never done something like this before.
Human skin feels so soft...
translation: 人类的皮肤竟然这么柔软...

text: ...Be gentle.
I'll never be acceptin' this!
Now, now, Toji.
Winnin' people's sympathy, justifying yer actions, trampling on the dead,
translation: 博取同情、自我辩解、践踏逝者——

text: yer ten years early for finding happiness!
translation: 想获得幸福还早十年呢！

text: That might be true, but I want to be with Mana.
translation: 或许是这样没错，但我想和真名在一起。

text: And I want to be with Shinji, too.
The entire class is worried about you two.
translation: 全班同学都在担心你们俩啊。

text:
I don't care if I'm despised for being selfish,
I'm leaving with Mana.
translation: 就算被说自私遭人白眼也无所谓——我要和真波一起离开。

text: That's what we've decided.
Ye idiot! Bigot! Moron!
translation: 你这蠢货！顽固分子！白痴！

text:
Oh my, is this finally the end of the story
for the Third Child, Shinji Ikari?
translation: 哎呀呀，第三少年碇真嗣的故事终于要迎来结局了吗？

text: Sorry.

Rather apologize than be sorry!
......Well, that's 'bout all I can say.
translation: 与其事后后悔不如现在道歉！......不过我也只能说到这份上了。

text: Right?
Well, now that the number of rivals is going down,
translation: 既然竞争对手正在减少

text:
maybe I, Aida Kensuke, will finally become
the pilot of Evangelion!
translation: 说不定我——相田剑介终于能成为EVA驾驶员了呢！

text: Bwahahahaha!
Hey, Master, I dunno if yer right or not,
translation: 喂，主人，我不知道您说得对不对，

text: just don't forget 'bout us. It's too sad to part like this.
translation: 但千万别忘了我们呀。就这样分别实在太让人难过了。

text: The sun is blinding.
It's a really sunny day, isn't it?
translation: 今天真是个大晴天呢，对吧？

text: Did you rent this room?

It's the last hideout,
it'll be eventually discovered by the military.
translation:
作为最后的藏身之处，
迟早会被军方发现的。

text: That's bad! We have escape soon.
translation: 糟了！我们得赶紧逃走才行。

text: "A true samurai knows compassion."
Eh? What do you mean by that?

That there are people out there thinking
about us, and offering us a refuge.
translation:
意思是这世上还有人惦记着我们，
正为我们提供避风港呢。

text: You're so mature, I feel like I'm just tagging along.
translation: 你这么成熟，感觉我就像个跟屁虫一样。

text: I've grown up, and you've become a man, Shinji.
translation: 我已经长大了，而你也成长为男子汉了呢，真嗣。

text: Somehow, that sounded kind of naughty.
translation: 总觉得这话听起来有点不正经。

text: I guess so.
Hey, let's book a train and go to our new home.
translation: 喂，我们订张车票去新家吧。

text: I'll follow you anywhere, Mana.
translation: 无论去哪里我都会跟着你的，真名。

text:
Also, there's a few things we need
the NERV people to do for us.
translation: 另外还有些事需要NERV的人帮我们处理。

text: The final procedure.
Following the manual written in this file,
translation: 按照这份文件里写的手册

text:
a minimum living standard is guaranteed.
When you no longer need the file,
translation:
最低限度的生活保障是没问题的。
当你不再需要这份文件时

text: I want you to burn it.

Each book is easily a thousand pages long.
I never knew
translation:
每本书都厚达千页以上
我从来不知道

text:
there's so many documents about
people leaving.
translation:
关于人员离职的文件
竟然有这么多

text:
These are the documents for
leaving secret organizations.
translation:
这些都是脱离秘密组织的
手续文件

text: There's governmental procedure handbooks, documents for schools, and employment security office,
translation:
有政府流程手册、学校文件
就业保障办公室的资料

text:
guides for future career paths,
a health insurance handbook,
translation:
未来职业规划指南
健康保险手册

text:
and beginners guide to using
the general household network systems.
translation:
以及使用普通家庭网络系统的
新手教程

text:
Kirishima's records have all been
purged from the database.
translation:
雾岛的所有记录都已被
从数据库中清除

text: From today on, you'll be free.
Thank you very much.
Also, there's a message.
Who is it from?

It's from Misato. She said that she couldn't
come, but sends her best regards.
translation: 是美里小姐。她说自己来不了，但送上问候。

text: I see...
You're wondering about Asuka, right?
Did something happen?
Asuka went to Kaji's place.
translation: 明日香去加持先生那里了。

text: Asuka and Kaji...

It's just a rumor,
but supposedly they're living together now.
translation:
虽然只是传闻，
但据说他们现在同居了。

text: I see.
Misato is now living by herself.
It's my fault, isn't it?
That's not it. I rather welcome it.
translation: 才不是呢。我倒觉得这样挺好。

text:
Well, since you work at the
Central Operations Command Center,
translation: 毕竟你在中央作战司令部工作

text:
it's kind of natural to think it's
a good thing, for NERV's sake.
translation: 从NERV的角度考虑会觉得这样更合适吧

text: That's not it.
Eh?

This is the first time I've
spoken to anyone about this, but...
translation: 虽然这是第一次对人说起这件事……

text: ...Yes?
I'm in love with Misato.
...Hyuga?
It's been a secret between me and Misato. And,
translation: 这是我和美里之间的秘密。而且，

text:
I should probably feel a bit sorry for Kaji.
I'm also aware it might make
translation:
我或许该对加持感到些许愧疚。
我也明白这可能会让

text:
some people feel uneasy,
but I intend to move forward with it.
translation:
某些人感到不安，
但我仍打算继续推进这件事。

text: I want Misato. That's who I really am.
translation: 我想要美里。这才是我真实的心意。

text: Hyuga with Misato, huh...?

That's why, rather than advising you on
what's right and what's not,
translation: 所以比起对你指手画脚，

text: I just want to keep an eye on things.
translation: 我更想静静守望事态发展。

text: Heya!
Asuka!

A wife-style apron, environtment saving plastic bag,
a hairstyle to keep the hair from falling
translation: 人妻风的围裙、环保塑料袋、防止头发掉进锅里的发型

text:
into the cooking pot, and shoes that you can
use at the kitchen too... So the rumors were true...
translation: 还有连在厨房也能穿的鞋子...看来传闻是真的啊...

text: Stop! Don't say another word.
You always appear at the most sweet moments, Asuka.
translation: 你总是出现在最甜蜜的时刻呢，明日香。

text:
Since this is the last time we meet,
I wanted to greet you nicely.
translation:
既然这是最后一次见面，
我想好好跟你打个招呼。

text:
Asuka, I don't really know
what to say about various things...
translation:
明日香，关于很多事情...
我实在不知道该怎么表达...

text: That's alright.
Thank you again for helping us.
translation: 再次感谢你帮助了我们。

text:
Words are meaningless, so just send me
a bottle of soy sauce instead.
translation: 言语毫无意义，不如寄瓶酱油给我吧。

text: Or maybe I'd rather have rice~, or something.
translation: 或者人家更想要大米啦~之类的。

text:
I need to go now,
I wish you'll find your happiness, Kirishima.
translation:
我该走了呢
希望你能找到属于自己的幸福，雾岛同学。

text: Yeah.
Asuka, wait!
What is it?
Are you going to stop piloting Eva now?
Right now, I'm doing my best, day by day.
translation: 现在的我啊，正在脚踏实地地努力生活着。

text:
But, when the time comes to pilot again,
I might find happiness doing it.
translation:
不过等到下次需要驾驶的时候
说不定能在战斗中找到幸福呢

text:
But, when the time comes to pilot again,
I might find happiness doing it.
translation:
不过等到下次需要驾驶的时候
说不定能在战斗中找到幸福呢

text:
Let's meet again someday!
Stay healthy, you two!
translation:
后会有期啦！
你们两个都要保重身体哦！

text: It feels like everyone's moving further away from me.
translation: 总觉得大家离我越来越远了。

text: Does it feel lonely?
Just a little.
I see...
It can't be helped, because I chose this path.
translation: 这也是没办法的事，毕竟是我自己选择的道路。

text: Maybe the world you live in is different than mine.
translation: 或许你生活的世界和我的并不相同。

text: What are you saying? We're going to be together from now on, right?
translation: 说什么傻话？从今往后我们都要在一起啊。

text: Yeah, you're right.
We can do this together.
Thank you.
